Adversarial direction reversal requires a perturbation bound of 0.21--0.27 times stimulus contrast in flyvis versus 0.13--0.25 in CNNs, but the gap over a parameter-matched CNN largely closes for larger CNNs. At the level of mechanism, matching attribution to the intervention matters: for held-out-mean replacement, first-order edge attribution patching reaches pooled AUROC 0.970 and Spearman 0.872, versus 0.933 and 0.126 when its zero-aligned score is evaluated against the same ground truth. Circuit conclusions also vary with representation and ensemble member. Greedy cell-type sets meet a model-relative T4/T5 tuning criterion in 25 of 50 models, while T4/T5 output silencing reduces the tested optic-flow behaviour to at most two of eight clips in 40. In six models where the cell-type search first succeeds, the corresponding connection sets can be pruned to 13--31 added classes; under an additional two-sided response-amplitude check, only two of those six first-success cell-type sets still meet the tuning threshold. These results support a narrower use of connectome-constrained models: they make mechanistic hypotheses directly testable, but the resulting claims must be scoped to the model family, intervention, representation and trained solution.

AI.tldr: 该论文以果蝇运动视觉模型flyvis为对象，系统压力测试了连接组约束神经网络在行为与机制结论上对比较模型、干预方式、回路表征和训练解的依赖性，主张相关机制主张必须限定于特定的模型家族、干预、表征与训练解。
AI.motivation: 连接组约束神经网络使生物组分可直接被干预，但其机制结论可能依赖于比较模型、干预方式、回路表征和训练解，这一稳健性问题尚未被系统检验。
AI.method: 使用flyvis（果蝇运动视觉模型）的50模型集成、任务匹配的因果CNN对照以及重复干预，在行为层面检验reverse-phi反转、对抗性方向反转和参数匹配比较；在机制层面比较归因方法与干预的匹配性（held-out-mean替换下的一阶edge attribution patching与其零对齐分数）、考察回路结论随表征与集成成员的变化，并检验T4/T5调谐判据、输出沉默效应及连接集剪枝。
AI.result: 行为上，flyvis的三级reverse-phi反转强依赖周期与速度，且同样出现在任务匹配CNN中，两者均未能复现果蝇的stationary-sawtooth响应；对抗性方向反转在flyvis中需0.21–0.27倍刺激对比度的扰动界，CNN为0.13–0.25，但与参数匹配CNN的差距在更大CNN中基本消失。机制上，归因与干预匹配至关重要：held-out-mean替换下，一阶edge attribution patching达到AUROC 0.970、Spearman 0.872，而其零对齐分数为0.933和0.126。回路结论随表征与集成成员变化：贪心细胞类型集在50个模型中仅25个满足模型相对的T4/T5调谐判据；T4/T5输出沉默仅在40个模型中的至多2/8个片段上降低所测光流行为；在6个首次成功的模型中连接集可剪枝至13–31个新增类，但附加双侧响应幅度检查后仅2/6仍满足调谐阈值。
AI.conclusion: 连接组约束模型使机制假设可直接检验，但所得主张必须限定于特定模型家族、干预、表征与训练解，支持更窄范围的使用。

title: EmbodiedCLBench: Evaluating Continual Learning for Self-Evolving Embodied Agents
summary: Continual learning requires models to accumulate past experience and transfer it to new tasks. Despite substantial research on continual learning, existing work remains largely confined to non-embodied settings, without extending to embodied environments. To address this gap, we introduce EmbodiedCLBench, the first benchmark in embodied simulation for evaluating the continual learning capability of self-evolving agents. With compositional generalization as the core evaluation principle, our benchmark evaluates whether agents can first learn from basic tasks and then recombine the acquired skills to solve complex, unseen advanced tasks. Based on EmbodiedCLBench, we conduct extensive experiments across multiple agent harnesses and learning methods, revealing consistent limitations and distinctive behaviors. Our results show that while advanced tasks can be hardly solved under zero-shot setting, the experience from basic tasks enables consistent improvement. Such benefit from the experience remains stable even if the task complexity increases. However, this improvement does not scale accordingly with the number of learning samples, and current agents cannot extract meaningful information from additional experience. Collectively, our findings highlight continual learning as a fundamental yet underexplored capability, and our benchmark offers valuable resources for designing effective self-evolving agents in embodied environments. Our code and dataset are available at https://pku-value-lab.github.io/EmbodiedCLBench-homepage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EmbodiedCLBench——首个面向具身仿真环境、用于评估自演化智能体持续学习能力的基准。该基准以组合泛化为核心原则，检验智能体能否从基础任务中学习并重组技能以解决未见的高级任务。实验揭示：零样本难以解决高级任务，基础任务经验可带来稳定提升且随复杂度增加保持稳定，但提升不随学习样本数量扩展，现有智能体难以从额外经验中提取有效信息。
AI.motivation: 持续学习要求模型积累过往经验并迁移至新任务，但现有研究大多局限于非具身设定，尚未扩展到具身环境，因此缺少针对具身智能体持续学习能力的评测手段。
AI.method: 构建 EmbodiedCLBench 基准：在具身仿真环境中评测自演化智能体的持续学习能力，并以组合泛化为核心评估原则——先学习基础任务，再重组已获技能以解决复杂、未见的高级任务。基于该基准，跨多种智能体框架（harness）与学习方法开展大量实验。
AI.result: 高级任务在零样本设定下几乎无法解决；基础任务经验能带来持续且一致的性能提升；该收益在任务复杂度增加时仍保持稳定；但提升并不随学习样本数量同比例增长，现有智能体无法从额外经验中提取有意义的信息。
AI.conclusion: 持续学习是一项基础但尚未被充分探索的能力；该基准为设计具身环境中有效的自演化智能体提供了有价值的资源，代码与数据集已开源。

title: Unified Generative Video Compression with Autoregressive and Bidirectional Video Diffusion
summary: Video diffusion models can reconstruct visually compelling content from severely compressed representations at ultra-low bitrates, but they impose a rigid deployment trade-off. Bidirectional (BI) models achieve high quality through dense full-sequence attention, yet require the entire sequence before reconstruction and incur substantial latency. Autoregressive (AR) models enable low-delay streaming, but their restricted temporal context reduces compression efficiency. This tension is particularly relevant when a video stream must be decoded in real time yet is also stored for later, quality-oriented playback, making AR and BI models natural choices for the live and replay stages, respectively. To support both stages, we present UniGVC, a Unified Generative Video Codec that supports two decoding modes from a single bitstream. UniGVC-BI employs a BI-DiT with dense attention for quality-oriented random-access decoding, whereas UniGVC-AR uses windowed AR-DiT for low-delay streaming. Both paths share a hierarchical latent codec that recurrently produces the same conditions with ultra-low bitrates, allowing UniGVC-BI to serve as a conditional teacher for single-step distillation of UniGVC-AR. A tiny conditional video decoder further reduces streaming latency while preserving most of the reconstruction quality. On standard 1080p benchmarks, UniGVC-BI achieves the best overall rate-distortion-perception trade-off among the evaluated methods and produces temporally stable video at rates as low as 0.0005 bits per pixel. Meanwhile, UniGVC-AR remains competitive while decoding 1080p video at 36.85 FPS, over $250\times$ faster than UniGVC-BI. Code and models will be released later.

AI.tldr: 本文提出统一生成式视频编解码器 UniGVC，可从单一码流支持 BI 与 AR 两种解码模式，兼顾高质量随机访问与低延迟流式传输。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散模型在超低码率下重建质量优异，但存在部署权衡：双向（BI）模型依赖全序列稠密注意力，质量高却需完整序列、延迟大；自回归（AR）模型支持低延迟流式解码，但时间上下文受限、压缩效率低。现实场景中视频既要实时解码又要留存高质量回放，因此需要同时支持直播与回放两种阶段。
AI.method: 提出 UniGVC。BI 路径使用带稠密注意力的 BI-DiT，用于面向质量的随机访问解码；AR 路径使用窗口化 AR-DiT，用于低延迟流式。两条路径共享分层隐式编解码器，以超低码率递归产生相同条件；据此让 UniGVC-BI 作为条件教师，对 UniGVC-AR 进行单步蒸馏。另引入轻量条件视频解码器以进一步降低流式延迟。
AI.result: 在标准 1080p 基准上，UniGVC-BI 在所评估方法中取得最佳整体率-失真-感知权衡，并在低至 0.0005 bpp 的码率下生成时间稳定的视频；UniGVC-AR 保持竞争力，1080p 解码达 36.85 FPS，比 UniGVC-BI 快 250 倍以上。
AI.conclusion: UniGVC 通过单一码流统一 BI 与 AR 解码，缓解了压缩效率与部署延迟之间的固有矛盾，实现了高质量回放与低延迟流式传输的兼顾。代码与模型将后续发布。

title: What Visual Representations Do World Action Models Need?
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) inherit powerful priors from pretrained video generation models, but their variational autoencoder (VAE) representations are optimized for visual reconstruction rather than manipulation. External visual representations can improve manipulation, but existing methods couple representation choices with different integration mechanisms, obscuring their individual effects. We systematically compare visual representations, five integration mechanisms, and feature combinations under controlled settings. Our study yields three main findings. First, strong general-purpose visual representations provide broader robustness gains and can match or outperform representations pretrained for specific visual capabilities. Second, channel-wise joint prediction achieves the highest average success rate; further analyses suggest that future-feature prediction and the action expert's effective use of added visual information contribute to its gains. Third, additional sources should be selected for the task-relevant information they contribute beyond existing representations, as the same source can help one combination but harm another. However, even the best evaluated composition provides a smaller additional gain than the initial improvement from adding a strong general-purpose representation to the VAE-only baseline. We instantiate the resulting Representation Recipe as R$^2$-WAM. It achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop with an 84.7% success rate and reaches 92.8% on RoboTwin 2.0, improving over the VAE-only baselines by 5.9 and 2.2 percentage points, respectively. Taken together, these findings suggest that future work should prioritize stronger general-purpose visual representations and more effective mechanisms for integrating them into WAMs, with feature composition serving as a supplementary route to improvement.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统对比了WAM中的视觉表征、五种集成机制与特征组合，提出R²-WAM，在RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop与RoboTwin 2.0上分别达到84.7%与92.8%成功率。
AI.motivation: World Action Models（WAMs）虽继承预训练视频生成模型的强先验，但其VAE表征针对视觉重建而非操作任务优化；引入外部视觉表征虽有帮助，但已有方法将表征选择与集成机制耦合，难以区分各自作用。
AI.method: 在受控设置下系统比较视觉表征、五种集成机制及特征组合，并据此实例化为Representation Recipe，即R²-WAM。
AI.result: （1）强通用视觉表征带来更广的鲁棒性增益，可匹配或超越特定视觉能力的预训练表征；（2）通道级联合预测取得最高平均成功率，未来特征预测与动作专家对新增视觉信息的有效利用是其增益来源；（3）额外来源应按其相对现有表征的任务相关信息贡献来选择。R²-WAM在RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop达84.7%，RoboTwin 2.0达92.8%，较仅VAE基线分别提升5.9与2.2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 最优组合带来的额外增益仍小于从VAE-only基线加入强通用表征的初始提升，未来应优先发展更强的通用视觉表征及更有效的集成机制，特征组合作为补充路径。

title: Evo$^2$: Evolving the Evolver through Weight-Harness Co-Evolution
summary: Self-evolving agents are increasingly used to improve language model systems without human intervention through either weight updates or harness improvements. Existing approaches typically pursue these directions separately: some methods update model weights using self-generated experience, while others rewrite the harness that defines how an agent uses prompts, tools, context, and execution feedback. However, these approaches overlook the relationship between model weights and the agent harness. To connect these processes and ensure effective and smooth agent self-evolving, we propose Evo$^2$, a framework for weight-harness co-evolution. For harness updates, we design a unified dual-role pipeline that a single policy serves as both a Proposer, which writes harness edits, and a Reflector, which diagnoses their effects and guides revision. For weight updates, harness modifications and their execution outcomes guide the training of both the Proposer and the Reflector. We further develop EvoTIDE, a training pipeline that recovers usable trajectories through edit extraction and prefix continuation, then combines SFT with interleaved GRPO across the two roles. Extensive experiments across three coding benchmarks demonstrate that Evo$^2$ significantly outperforms existing self-evolution methods. It achieves 82.1% on Polyglot and 48.3% on SWE-bench Verified, compared with 62.6% and 41.0% for the strongest baseline, respectively. We also show that the evolved harnesses transfer to different tasks without further evolution and rank first in cross-benchmark evaluations. Our dual-role harness improvement framework is also able to extend to self-evolution with proprietary models, improving a GPT-5-mini agent's performance from 24.4% to 48.3%. These results demonstrate the applicability of the framework Evo$^2$ across domains and its broad transferability across models and tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Evo$^2$框架，实现模型权重与智能体harness的协同进化，在多个编码基准上显著超越现有自进化方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体方法将权重更新与harness改进分开进行，忽略了模型权重与智能体harness之间的关系，难以保证高效顺畅的自进化。
AI.method: Evo$^2$框架进行权重-harness协同进化：harness更新采用统一双角色流水线，单一策略同时充当Proposer（编写harness编辑）与Reflector（诊断效果并指导修订）；权重更新由harness修改及其执行结果引导训练两个角色。并提出EvoTIDE训练流水线，通过编辑提取与前缀延续恢复可用轨迹，结合SFT与跨两角色的交错GRPO。
AI.result: 在三个编码基准上显著优于现有自进化方法：Polyglot达82.1%（最强基线62.6%），SWE-bench Verified达48.3%（最强基线41.0%）；进化后的harness可迁移到不同任务且无需进一步进化，在跨基准评测中排名第一；该双角色框架还能扩展到专有模型自进化，将GPT-5-mini智能体从24.4%提升至48.3%。
AI.conclusion: Evo$^2$框架具有跨领域的适用性以及跨模型和跨任务的广泛迁移能力。

title: Dataset-Specific Encoding of Image Content Underlies Cross-Dataset Failure in Brain MRI Foundation Models
summary: Frozen features of brain MRI foundation models lose accuracy on new datasets, a failure usually blamed on the features encoding where each scan came from. We show that the failure lies elsewhere. Across 17 public datasets and eight frozen representations, every representation recognizes the MRI sequence within each dataset, yet most fail on an unseen one. The cause is neither dataset encoding nor a shift of each dataset: the content itself is encoded along different directions in each dataset. This explains which datasets fail, for the sequence and for sex, and why removing the dataset signal with INLP, LEACE, CORAL or adversarial training never improves sequence transfer. Only the broadly pretrained 3DINO and SAM-Med3D encode the sequence consistently enough to transfer; the brain-specific BrainIAC and BrainFM do no better than an untrained network. Code is available at https://github.com/BrainFM/brainfm-profiler/tree/main/representation_utility.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出冻结的脑MRI基础模型特征在新数据集上失效的原因并非数据集来源信息被编码，而是同一内容在不同数据集中被编码在不同方向上。
AI.motivation: 通常认为冻结特征在新数据集上泛化差是因为特征编码了扫描来源（数据集信息），论文旨在检验这一假设并寻找真正原因。
AI.method: 在17个公开数据集和8种冻结表示上，测试各表示对数据集内MRI序列的识别能力及跨数据集迁移能力；并采用INLP、LEACE、CORAL和对抗训练移除数据集信号，检验是否能改善序列迁移。
AI.result: 每种表示都能在每个数据集内识别MRI序列，但多数在未见数据集上失效；移除数据集信号的方法均无法改善序列迁移。仅广泛预训练的3DINO和SAM-Med3D能一致编码序列并实现迁移，而脑专用的BrainIAC和BrainFM表现不优于未训练网络。
AI.conclusion: 冻结表示失效的根源是内容在不同数据集中被编码于不同方向，而非数据集编码或分布偏移；这解释了序列和性别任务的失败模式，也说明去除数据集信号无助于迁移。

title: GeoGR: Spatial-Semantic Token Compression and Group Routing for Efficient 3D VLMs
summary: Multi-view representations enable pretrained image and video vision-language models to understand 3D scenes, but their long visual token sequences make inference costly. Redundancy arises both from repeated observations of the same scene regions across views and from processing all visual tokens at every LLM layer, regardless of their relevance to the current computation. We propose GeoGR, a two-stage framework that jointly compresses scene representations and visual computation. At the projector level, GeoSemZip consolidates cross-view observations into 3D voxel tokens and combines semantic saliency with spatial coverage to construct a compact scene representation. Unselected voxel features are aggregated into contextual anchors to retain scene information that would otherwise be discarded. At the LLM level, we identify an effective visual computation window and observe that query-conditioned token relevance remains locally stable but changes over longer layer intervals. Guided by these findings, GroupRoute combines late entry and early exit with recoverable group-wise skipping. Low-relevance tokens bypass complete LLM layers while retaining their hidden states and can rejoin the active group at subsequent anchor layers selected under a computation budget. For compression-aware post-training, we construct a compact dataset of 67K samples by retaining 30% of the original training pool. With this protocol, GeoGR retains 95.2% and 96.8% of the dense post-trained models' performance on LLaVA-OneVision-7B and Video-3D LLM-7B, respectively, while accelerating LLM prefill by $6.8\times$ and $6.1\times$. These results demonstrate the consistent effectiveness of GeoGR across 3D VLMs with and without explicit 3D spatial encoding, highlighting a favorable performance-efficiency trade-off. The code is available at https://github.com/EIT-NLP/GeoGR.

AI.tldr: GeoGR是一个两阶段框架，通过同时压缩场景表示与视觉计算来降低多视图3D视觉语言模型的高昂推理成本。其项目器级模块GeoSemZip将跨视图观测融合为3D体素token并构建紧凑场景表示；LLM级模块GroupRoute结合晚进入、早退出与可恢复分组跳层，将低相关token绕过完整LLM层。在仅保留30%训练样本的后训练协议下，GeoGR在LLaVA-OneVision-7B和Video-3D LLM-7B上分别保留95.2%和96.8%的稠密模型性能，同时将LLM预填充加速6.8倍与6.1倍。
AI.motivation: 多视图表示使预训练图像和视频视觉语言模型能够理解3D场景，但其冗长的视觉token序列导致推理成本高昂。冗余来源于两方面：一是不同视图对同一场景区域的重复观测，二是在每一LLM层都处理全部视觉token，而不论其与当前计算的相关性。
AI.method: 提出GeoGR两阶段框架，联合压缩场景表示与视觉计算。项目器层面：GeoSemZip将跨视图观测整合为3D体素token，融合语义显著性与空间覆盖度构建紧凑场景表示，并将未选中的体素特征聚合成上下文锚点以保留信息。LLM层面：识别有效的视觉计算窗口，发现查询条件化的token相关性在局部稳定但在较长层间隔上变化；据此提出GroupRoute，结合晚进入与早退出以及可恢复的分组跳层，低相关token绕过完整LLM层但保留隐藏状态，并可在后续锚点层重新加入活跃组。压缩感知后训练方面，通过保留原始训练池30%构建67K样本的紧凑数据集。
AI.result: 在该后训练协议下，GeoGR在LLaVA-OneVision-7B和Video-3D LLM-7B上分别保留稠密后训练模型95.2%与96.8%的性能，同时将LLM预填充加速6.8倍与6.1倍。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了GeoGR在有无显式3D空间编码的3D VLM上均具有一致有效性，展现出良好的性能—效率权衡。代码已开源。

title: RAMP: Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision for Efficient Prefill in Recurrent-Depth Language Models
summary: Recurrent-depth language models improve inference-time reasoning by repeatedly applying a shared network to refine internal representations, but the additional recurrent computation also increases inference cost. This overhead is particularly pronounced during long-context prefill, where the full input sequence is repeatedly processed across recurrent depth. Weight-and-activation quantization offers a natural way to accelerate this computation through lower-precision arithmetic, yet repeatedly applying quantized computation introduces numerical perturbations that accumulate along the recurrent trajectory. We systematically analyze how such errors propagate across recurrent depth and show that quantization errors introduced earlier are attenuated by more subsequent recurrent steps and therefore have a smaller effect on the final representation. Matched-budget experiments strongly support this prediction, showing that placing quantized computation earlier in recurrent depth consistently yields the best fidelity. Based on this insight, we introduce RAMP (Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision), which performs early recurrent refinement using low-precision weight-and-activation computation and restores high precision for terminal refinement. Across context lengths up to 4K, RAMP preserves near-full-precision prefill quality while achieving up to 1.16x end-to-end first-prefill speedup on an NVIDIA H100, corresponding to a 13.9% latency reduction.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析循环深度语言模型中量化误差沿循环轨迹的传播规律，发现早期引入的量化误差会被后续循环步骤衰减，据此提出RAMP混合精度策略：早期循环用低精度、末端循环恢复高精度，在4K上下文内保持近乎全精度质量，并实现最高1.16倍首预填加速（延迟降低13.9%）。
AI.motivation: 循环深度语言模型通过在推理时重复应用共享网络来精炼内部表示，从而提升推理能力，但额外的循环计算增加了推理开销，尤其在长上下文预填充阶段，整个输入序列需沿循环深度被反复处理。权重与激活量化是加速该类计算的天然手段，然而重复应用量化计算会引入沿循环轨迹累积的数值扰动。因此，作者希望系统理解这些误差如何在循环深度上传播，从而指导混合精度设计以降低预填充成本。
AI.method: 作者系统分析量化误差沿循环深度的传播机制，提出并验证假设：越早引入的量化误差会被越多后续循环步骤衰减，因而对最终表示影响越小。通过匹配预算（matched-budget）实验对该预测进行验证。基于此洞察提出RAMP（Recurrent Adaptive Mixed Precision）：在早期循环精炼阶段使用低精度权重与激活计算，在末端精炼阶段恢复高精度。
AI.result: 匹配预算实验强力支持了理论预测：在循环深度中把量化计算放在更早位置，一致地获得最佳保真度。在最长4K的上下文长度下，RAMP在保持近乎全精度预填充质量的同时，于NVIDIA H100上实现最高1.16倍的端到端首预填加速，对应13.9%的延迟降低。
AI.conclusion: 量化误差在循环深度中具有衰减特性，误差越早引入所受后续衰减越多、影响越小，这一规律可用于指导混合精度分配。RAMP通过在早期循环使用低精度、末端恢复高精度，在不牺牲预填充质量的前提下有效加速长上下文预填充，验证了该原则的实用价值。

title: Redirecting Teacher Supervision: Temporal-Response-Guided Latent Distillation for Video-Language Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers capabilities through teacher predictions on student-generated sequences, as studied by GKD and MiniLLM for language models and Video-OPD for video tasks. We ask how internal supervision can further support temporal learning. Direct hidden-state alignment does not explicitly use the student's temporal responses to choose a supervision direction. We propose Temporal-Response Guidance (TRG), which measures representation responses to local temporal perturbations, adds the teacher correction's projection onto their span back to the original correction, and restores its original norm. The projection is not normalized separately, and correction components outside the response space are retained. With an orthogonal tangent projector and a detached target, TRG changes the supervision direction while preserving the cosine-loss value and aligned-representation gradient norm at target construction. On TempCompass, Video-MME, MVBench, and Video-MMMU, TRG improves the 4B student's macro accuracy by 2.86 percentage points over the reported output-only OPD baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出Temporal-Response Guidance (TRG)，通过度量学生表示对局部时间扰动的响应来确定隐藏状态对齐的监督方向，在多个视频基准上提升4B学生的宏平均准确率2.86个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy蒸馏（OPD）通过教师对学生生成序列的预测传递能力，但直接进行隐藏状态对齐时，并未显式利用学生自身的时间响应来选择监督方向，内部监督对时序学习的支持不足。
AI.method: TRG度量表示对局部时间扰动的响应，将教师修正投影到该响应张成空间后加回原修正，并恢复原范数；投影不单独归一化，响应空间外的修正分量予以保留。采用正交切向投影器与detached目标，在目标构造时保持cosine损失值与对齐表示梯度范数不变，仅改变监督方向。
AI.result: 在TempCompass、Video-MME、MVBench和Video-MMMU上，TRG相较已报告的仅输出OPD基线，使4B学生的宏平均准确率提升2.86个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 利用学生自身的时间响应来引导隐藏状态对齐方向，可在不改变cosine损失值与梯度范数的前提下有效提升视频时序学习的蒸馏效果。

title: Space Over Statistic, Retraining Over Ranking: Auditing Training Labels Under Label-Only Backdoors
summary: Some backdoor attacks never touch an image. FLIP only changes labels: on CIFAR-10, flipping 3% of them makes a ResNet-32 send 99.7% of triggered source-class images to the attacker's class. The usual defenses look for the poison inside a model trained on those same labels. So when they struggle, is the problem the test they run, or the space they run it in? We answer with a controlled swap: we keep the test, the labels and the metric fixed, change only the feature space, and judge each defense by retraining the victim on what it keeps. The space decides. On dog$\to$cat the same nearest-neighbor check scores AUROC 0.546 on the poisoned model's features, 0.967 on frozen DINOv2 features that never saw a label, and 0.995 on the same network trained on clean labels, an oracle control rather than a defense. We reproduce SPECTRE, the defense FLIP's authors recommend, to 90.94 / 0.97 against its published 91.47 / 1.7, then price it: on truck$\to$deer it deletes 20% of every class, while a prototype audit on the frozen features deletes 6% for higher clean accuracy and lower attack success. On three harder pairs that audit leaves about a quarter of the attack standing. A count read off encoder geometry and clean labels, before any attack is run, separates the pair where the audit removes the attack from those where it only partly does, though on a single zero-count pair. Three results warn against the easy story. A better detection score does not mean a safer model: on two of four pairs Confident Learning scores the higher AUROC, and on dog$\to$cat leaves 2.6 times the attack success. The prototype family, our best static performer, is the first an adaptive attacker slips past. And past a point, catching more poisons stops reducing attack success. Check labels in a space that never learned them, and judge a defense by the retrained model, not by its detection score.

AI.tldr: 本文研究标签翻转（label-flipping）后门攻击下防御评估的问题：在固定测试、标签与指标、仅改变特征空间的受控对比中发现，"特征空间"而非"检测测试"决定防御成败；应以重训练后的受害模型而非检测AUROC来评判防御。
AI.motivation: FLIP等纯标签翻转攻击不修改图像，仅翻转少量标签即可让模型将触发源类样本预测为攻击者类。常规防御在同一标签上训练的模型中寻找毒化痕迹，效果不稳定。作者试图厘清：防御失效的原因在于检测测试本身，还是检测所运行的特征空间？因此需要固定检测方法、标签与指标，只替换特征空间进行受控比较。
AI.method: 受控特征空间替换实验：保持检测器（如最近邻检查）、标签与评价指标不变，仅更换特征空间（毒化模型特征、冻结DINOv2特征、干净标签训练的模型特征作为oracle对照）；以在保留样本上重训练受害模型后的表现为评判标准。复现推荐防御SPECTRE并统计其类别删除代价；提出基于冻结特征的原型审计（prototype audit）；并利用编码器几何与干净标签在任何攻击前计算一个计数量，用于区分审计能否移除攻击；同时测试自适应攻击与Confident Learning对照。
AI.result: CIFAR-10上翻转3%标签可使ResNet-32将99.7%触发源类样本导向攻击者类。dog→cat上同一最近邻检查AUROC：毒化模型特征0.546、从未见过标签的冻结DINOv2特征0.967、干净标签训练网络0.995（oracle对照而非防御）。复现SPECTRE得90.94/0.97，原文91.47/1.7；truck→deer上其删除每类20%样本，而冻结特征上的原型审计仅删除6%且干净精度更高、攻击成功率更低。三个更难配对上该审计仍残留约四分之一攻击。计数量可分离审计完全移除与部分移除的配对，但仅基于单一零计数配对。四项警示：更高AUROC不等于更安全模型（四配对中两者Confident Learning AUROC更高，dog→cat上残留2.6倍攻击成功率）；最佳静态原型家族最先被自适应攻击绕过；超过某点后拦截更多毒化样本不再降低攻击成功率。
AI.conclusion: 防御评估的关键在于特征空间与最终重训练模型的安全性，而非检测分数本身。应在"从未学习标签"的空间中检查标签，并以重训练后的模型表现（干净精度与攻击成功率）评判防御，而非依赖检测AUROC。

title: NOFACE3D: NOise-scheduled Focused Anchoring and Controlled Enhancement for 3D Generation
summary: Recent image-to-3D models generate complete, high-quality assets from a single image, with global shape and appearance that are already convincing; what remains is the fine scale, where small, thin, elongated, or detail-rich regions are reconstructed softly and under-resolved. This gap can arise in generators with fixed-resolution spatial grids: the same spatial sampling density is used for a large, smooth, low-curvature surface and for a thin, high-curvature structure that carries most of the perceived detail. To this end, we introduce NOFACE3D, a training-free framework that refines these detail-critical regions while preserving the rest of the asset. Given a generated mesh, its input image, and a refinement box, NOFACE3D extracts the selected submesh, scales it up to fill the generator's input volume, and re-encodes it into the full-resolution latent grid. Conditioned on the image crop, it refines the region through flow-based sampling with a spatially varying noise schedule that anchors boundary latents. The refined region is then integrated back into the original asset, preserving the surrounding geometry and appearance. We implement NOFACE3D on TRELLIS.2 and its sparse voxel representation; all of it operates purely at inference time on the frozen pretrained generator. We evaluate NOFACE3D on PAniC-3D, TexVerse and BigDetail, a new benchmark of 339 assets with annotated detail-critical regions. On all three, it generates sharper geometry and finer texture detail than the baselines. Project page: https://idkcouscous.github.io/NoFACE3D/

AI.tldr: NOFACE3D：一种免训练框架，针对图像到3D生成结果中细小、薄、细长或细节丰富区域重建模糊的问题，在推理阶段对选定区域进行局部细化并回填，生成更锐利的几何与纹理。
AI.motivation: 现有图像到3D生成模型已能产出全局形状与外观可信的完整高质量资产，但细尺度区域（细小、薄、细长或细节丰富结构）重建偏软、分辨率不足。根源在于固定分辨率空间网格的生成器对大面积平滑低曲率表面与承载主要感知细节的薄且高曲率结构采用相同的空间采样密度。
AI.method: 提出NOFACE3D免训练框架：给定生成网格、输入图像与细化框，提取选定子网格，将其放大以填满生成器输入体积，并重新编码到全分辨率潜变量网格；以图像裁剪为条件，通过流式采样进行区域细化，采用空间变化的噪声调度以锚定边界潜变量；随后将细化区域整合回原始资产，保持周边几何与外观。在TRELLIS.2及其稀疏体素表示上实现，全部在冻结预训练生成器的推理阶段运行。
AI.result: 在PAniC-3D、TexVerse以及新基准BigDetail（339个带有细节关键区域标注的资产）上评估，三个数据集上均比基线生成更锐利的几何与更精细的纹理细节。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过推理期的局部放大与再编码细化，可在不重新训练生成器的前提下有效提升图像到3D资产的细节保真度，为细尺度重建提供了一种即插即用的解决方案。

title: UniMergeTrack: Hierarchical Model Merging for General RGB-X Visual Object Tracking
summary: RGB-X tracking leverages complementary modalities, such as thermal infrared, event, or depth, to improve robustness under challenging conditions. Existing general-purpose RGB-X trackers typically follow two paradigms: independent task-specific training and joint training across modality combinations. However, the former suffers from knowledge isolation and model redundancy, while the latter introduces optimization interference across heterogeneous tasks. In this work, we present UniMergeTrack, a new model merging paradigm that preserves task-specific optimization while enabling effective cross-task knowledge integration. UniMergeTrack first trains modality-specific trackers independently and then performs hierarchical model merging. Specifically, transferable backbones are merged across RGB-X tasks via high-pass-filtered merging, and complemented by lightweight task-specific experts that preserve modality-specific cues. Tracking heads are merged within each task using optimal transport-guided channel alignment to mitigate hidden channel mismatch. A subsequent distribution alignment fine-tuning stage further improves compatibility between the unified backbone and task-specific heads. Extensive experiments on the LasHeR, RGBT234, VisEvent, VOT-RGBD22, COESOT, and CDTB benchmarks demonstrate that UniMergeTrack achieves state-of-the-art or competitive performance across RGB-Thermal, RGB-Event, and RGB-Depth tracking tasks, while exhibiting strong generalization to unseen datasets. The source code will be released upon acceptance. The source code of this paper will be released on https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenEvTracking.

AI.tldr: 提出 UniMergeTrack，用分层模型合并取代联合训练，在保留各模态任务专属优化的同时实现跨任务知识整合，在 RGB-Thermal、RGB-Event、RGB-Depth 跟踪基准上达到 SOTA 或具有竞争力的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 RGB-X 跟踪器主要有两种范式：独立的任务专属训练与跨模态组合的联合训练。前者存在知识隔离和模型冗余问题，后者在异构任务间引入优化干扰。因此需要一个既能保留任务专属优化、又能有效整合跨任务知识的方案。
AI.method: UniMergeTrack 先独立训练各模态专属跟踪器，再进行分层模型合并：可迁移骨干网络通过高通滤波合并（high-pass-filtered merging）跨 RGB-X 任务融合，并由轻量级任务专属专家（task-specific experts）补充保留模态特定线索；跟踪头在每个任务内用最优传输引导的通道对齐（optimal transport-guided channel alignment）合并，以缓解隐藏通道不匹配；随后通过分布对齐微调（distribution alignment fine-tuning）提升统一骨干与任务专属头的兼容性。
AI.result: 在 LasHeR、RGBT234、VisEvent、VOT-RGBD22、COESOT、CDTB 等基准上的大量实验表明，UniMergeTrack 在 RGB-Thermal、RGB-Event、RGB-Depth 三类跟踪任务上取得 SOTA 或具有竞争力的性能，并对未见数据集表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 模型合并范式可有效替代联合训练，在避免优化干扰与知识隔离的同时实现跨任务知识整合，为多模态 RGB-X 跟踪提供统一且泛化性强的解决方案。源码将在接收后于 https://github.com/Event-AHU/OpenEvTracking 发布。

title: A4-MR: Abnormality-aware Anatomical Alignment for MR
summary: Recent advances in large-scale foundation models have enabled strong generalization across a wide range of clinical and research tasks in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI). However, existing vision-language MRI models remain limited in anatomy-specific localization and pathology-aware representation, particularly in real-world settings. We introduce A4-MR, a 3D vision-language foundation model trained on approximately 50,000 MRI studies comprising 491,000 series, roughly half of which are paired with radiology reports. A4-MR is designed to: (1) learn anatomy localization through large-scale pretraining with noisy labels; (2) align image and text representations at the anatomical level; and (3) learn distinct representations of healthy and abnormal anatomy. Across a diverse set of downstream tasks, A4-MR outperforms existing foundation models, including a +1.7 AUROC improvement over MedSigLIP for abnormality detection. Using a frozen encoder, A4-MR also surpasses an end-to-end task-specific MedNeXt model for knee segmentation by +1.4 Dice and performs comparably to the best task-specific model for abdominal organ segmentation on AMOS, within 0.4 Dice. Finally, without anatomical prompts, A4-MR localizes 3D anatomy comparably to MedSAM2 provided with ground-truth bounding boxes. Together, these results demonstrate that anatomy-level multimodal alignment and abnormality-aware representation learning can enable a single MRI foundation model to support localization, segmentation, and pathology-related tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出A4-MR，一个在约5万例MRI研究（49.1万序列）上训练的3D视觉-语言基础模型，通过解剖定位预训练、解剖级图文对齐及健康/异常解剖表征学习，在异常检测、分割与3D定位任务上超越现有基础模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MRI视觉-语言模型在解剖特异性定位与病理感知表征方面存在不足，难以适应真实临床场景。作者希望构建单一MRI基础模型同时支持定位、分割与病理相关任务。
AI.method: 构建A4-MR 3D视觉-语言基础模型，训练数据为约5万例MRI研究、49.1万序列，其中约一半配有放射报告。设计三个目标：(1) 利用大规模带噪标签预训练学习解剖定位；(2) 在解剖层面进行图像与文本表征对齐；(3) 学习健康与异常解剖的差异化表征。
AI.result: 在多类下游任务上A4-MR优于现有基础模型：异常检测AUROC较MedSigLIP提升+1.7；冻结编码器下膝关节分割Dice较端到端任务专用MedNeXt提升+1.4；在AMOS腹部器官分割上接近最佳任务专用模型（差距0.4 Dice）；无需解剖提示即可实现与提供真实框的MedSAM2相当的3D解剖定位。
AI.conclusion: 解剖级多模态对齐与异常感知表征学习可使单一MRI基础模型支持定位、分割及病理相关任务，验证了该预训练范式的通用性与有效性。

title: CoBe: A Benchmark For Conversational Counterfactual Text Editing
comment: accepted to NeurIPS'26 workshops on Trustworthy AI For Good (AI4GOOD) and Trustworthy AI Evaluations (TAE)
summary: Counterfactual text editing is the ability to revise a given text in light of a hypothetical change while preserving facts not causally affected by that change. When asked what would have happened if a doctor had not recommended surgery, the model output should retain the patient's medical history and modify only the consequences of the decision. This requires causal understanding: a model must determine, without being explicitly instructed to, what events are affected by the hypothetical change and what should remain fixed. This skill is central to human reasoning, especially in safety-critical domains like healthcare or law. By contrast, the task of associational text generation merely generates text statistically associated with the altered condition. In the medical example, an associational response might make the patient's symptoms less severe because milder cases correlate with no surgery. Such responses produce a plausible scenario, but not the counterfactual version of the given one. Prior counterfactual-text datasets do not clearly separate these modes of reasoning. We introduce the Counterfactual Benchmark (CoBe), a testbed for models' zero-shot ability to counterfactually edit a given textual scenario when prompted to do so in a conversationally natural way. CoBe contains 2000 questions spanning healthcare, science and engineering, business, and everyday scenarios. We test a suite of frontier and smaller models, with frontier systems achieving an average score of $58.05\%$. Our findings indicate that models frequently default to associational generation rather than preserving the causal structure of the original scenario. Moreover, performance does not scale consistently with either model size or output token length, suggesting that the failure may reflect model training objectives rather than insufficient model capacity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CoBe基准，用于评测模型在零样本条件下反事实文本编辑的能力，并发现前沿模型平均仅得58.05%，普遍退化为关联性生成。
AI.motivation: 反事实文本编辑要求模型在给定假设性变更下仅修改受因果影响的部分，保留无关事实，这对医疗、法律等安全关键领域至关重要；而现有反事实文本数据集未能清晰区分反事实推理与关联性生成，导致评测目标模糊。
AI.method: 构建CoBe（Counterfactual Benchmark），包含2000个问题，覆盖医疗、科学与工程、商业、日常场景；以对话式自然提示测试模型的零样本反事实编辑能力；对前沿模型与较小模型进行系统评测。
AI.result: 前沿系统平均得分58.05%；模型频繁默认进行关联性生成，而非保留原场景的因果结构；性能与模型规模或输出token长度没有一致的正相关。
AI.conclusion: 模型在反事实文本编辑上的失败可能源于训练目标而非模型容量不足，CoBe为区分反事实推理与关联性生成提供了专门测试平台。

title: Travel Back To Move Forward: Retrospective Exploration and Evolving for Long Horizon Agents
summary: Large language model agents increasingly operate in long-horizon environments where early mistakes can trigger cascading failures and trap agents in dead-end trajectories. Agents must therefore be able to proactively recover from such states and turn their exploratory experience into guidance for subsequent decisions. We introduce ReTRAIL, a framework that enables agents to rewind the environment to earlier states while preserving valid progress and carrying forward knowledge learned from abandoned exploration. The environment state moves backward while the agent's knowledge continues to move forward. ReTRAIL trains a shared policy with two complementary signals: State-Anchored GRPO compares alternative continuations from revisited states to improve execution, while a branch-advancement reward guides reflection through the progress of subsequent exploration. Experiments across four interactive benchmark MineSweeper, Sokoban, ALFWorld and ScienceWorld show that simply adding a rewind primitive provides limited benefit and can even degrade performance. In contrast, ReTRAIL enables agents to rewind from unproductive states and use insights from abandoned branches to guide subsequent exploration. These results demonstrate the value of coupling environment rewinding with experience reuse within an ongoing task for long-horizon task solving. The code is available at https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL.

AI.tldr: ReTRAIL 框架让 LLM 智能体在长程任务中回退环境状态的同时保留并复用被放弃探索分支的知识，通过 State-Anchored GRPO 与分支推进奖励训练共享策略，在四个交互式基准上优于单纯添加回退原语。
AI.motivation: 长程环境中早期错误会引发级联失败并把智能体困在死胡同轨迹中，因此智能体需要主动从这类状态中恢复，并将探索经验转化为后续决策的指导。
AI.method: ReTRAIL 允许环境回退到更早状态，同时保留有效进展并传递从被放弃探索中获得的知识（环境状态后退、智能体知识前进）。它用两个互补信号训练共享策略：State-Anchored GRPO 通过比较从重访状态出发的多种后续轨迹来改进执行；分支推进奖励（branch-advancement reward）利用后续探索的进展引导反思。
AI.result: 在 MineSweeper、Sokoban、ALFWorld 和 ScienceWorld 四个交互式基准上，仅添加回退原语收益有限甚至降低性能；而 ReTRAIL 能让智能体从无产出的状态回退，并利用被放弃分支的洞见指导后续探索。
AI.conclusion: 在长程任务求解中，将环境回退与持续任务内的经验复用相结合具有明确价值。代码开源在 https://github.com/whi497/ReTRAIL。

title: CliQ-RRG: Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation
summary: Radiology reports are essential for diagnostic reasoning and patient care, yet their manual preparation is time-consuming and cognitively demanding. Automatic radiology report generation (RRG) offers a scalable alternative, but existing models often produce lengthy, unstructured narratives that overlook diagnostic cues and multi-view information. We present Clinical-Knowledge Guided Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment for QA-Style Radiology Report Generation (CliQ-RRG), a unified two-stage framework for interpretable and clinically grounded reporting. In Stage 1, CliQ-RRG employs a Disease-aware Visual-Textual Alignment module that aligns image and text representations using predicted disease embeddings, reinforced by a Prior-Guided Attention Module (PrAM) to capture multi-view dependencies across current and prior scans. In Stage 2, GraphRAG-guided retrieval augments intermediate textual representations with graph-grounded clinical evidence, and a large language model restructures them into concise, interpretable question-answer (QA) pairs with diagnostic summaries. Experiments on two public chest X-ray benchmarks demonstrate that CliQ-RRG consistently outperforms prior methods across both lexical and clinical metrics, generating accurate and clinically coherent QA-style radiology reports. Code is available at: https://github.com/chandravardhan-singh-raghaw/CliQ-RRG.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架CliQ-RRG，结合疾病感知视觉-文本对齐与GraphRAG检索，生成简洁可解释的QA式放射报告。
AI.motivation: 放射报告人工撰写耗时且认知负荷高；现有自动放射报告生成（RRG）模型常生成冗长、无结构的叙述，忽视诊断线索与多视图信息，缺乏临床可解释性。
AI.method: 统一两阶段框架。阶段一：疾病感知视觉-文本对齐模块，利用预测的疾病嵌入对齐图像与文本表示，并由先验引导注意力模块（PrAM）捕获当前与既往扫描间的多视图依赖。阶段二：GraphRAG引导检索，用图结构临床证据增强中间文本表示，再由大语言模型重构为简洁、可解释的问答（QA）对及诊断摘要。
AI.result: 在两个公开胸部X光基准上，CliQ-RRG在词汇指标与临床指标上均持续优于既往方法，生成准确且临床连贯的QA式放射报告。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: CliQ-RRG通过疾病感知对齐与图检索增强，实现了可解释、临床落地的QA式放射报告生成，验证了两阶段设计的有效性。

title: KV-Repurpose: A Testbed for Evaluating Non-Prefix KV-Cache Reuse
summary: KV-cache reuse in large language model serving is commonly limited to exact prompt prefixes, preventing reuse when the same retrieved document appears after different system prompts, conversation histories, or dynamic metadata. We present KV-Repurpose, an open-source, vLLM-based system for developing and evaluating segment-wise KV-cache reuse beyond exact prefixes. The system combines cache-aware segment scheduling, prompt construction, capacity management, workload generation, and runtime monitoring. Experiments on long-context benchmarks show that naive segment reuse largely preserves output quality for single-document question answering and summarization, while exposing clear limitations in cross-document reasoning. Under a Zipfian RAG-style workload in which 20% of requests share a fixed prefix, KV-Repurpose achieves a substantially higher token-level cache hit rate than prefix caching at the same 30 GB cache capacity, 63.9% versus 3.3%, resulting in lower TTFT. Even with 1 TB of cache capacity, prefix caching reaches only a 17.9% hit rate in this workload. Source code is available under the Apache-2.0 license at https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose.

AI.tldr: 提出并开源了基于 vLLM 的 KV-Repurpose 系统，实现超越精确前缀的片段级 KV 缓存复用，在 Zipfian RAG 负载下将 token 级缓存命中率从前缀缓存的 3.3% 提升至 63.9%。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 服务中的 KV 缓存复用通常局限于精确的 prompt 前缀。当同一检索文档出现在不同的系统提示、对话历史或动态元数据之后时，无法复用缓存，导致命中率低、TTFT 高。作者希望突破这一限制，实现片段级（segment-wise）的 KV 缓存复用。
AI.method: 构建开源的、基于 vLLM 的系统 KV-Repurpose，集成缓存感知的片段调度、prompt 构造、容量管理、工作负载生成与运行时监控等模块，用于开发与评估超越精确前缀的片段级 KV 缓存复用。
AI.result: 长上下文基准实验显示：朴素片段复用在单文档问答与摘要任务上基本保持输出质量，但在跨文档推理上暴露明显局限。在 20% 请求共享固定前缀的 Zipfian RAG 负载下，相同 30 GB 缓存容量时，KV-Repurpose 的 token 级命中率达 63.9%，远高于前缀缓存的 3.3%，TTFT 更低；即使缓存容量达 1 TB，前缀缓存命中率也仅 17.9%。
AI.conclusion: 片段级 KV 缓存复用在特定负载下可显著优于精确前缀缓存，但存在跨文档推理的质量局限。系统以 Apache-2.0 许可开源（https://github.com/taiga333/eval-kv-repurpose），为后续研究提供平台。

title: Evolving Creatives with Clicks: CTR-Driven Advertising image Editing via Attribute Disentanglement and Preference Alignment
summary: The optimization objective for e-commerce advertising creatives has shifted from aesthetic quality to online business metrics like click-through rate (CTR). Recent methods generate appealing ad images from product images by constructing CTR-based reward signals and refining prompt generation via Reinforcement Learning. Such paradigms equally penalize all attributes within an underperforming image, even though some are actually beneficial to clicks. In this work, we propose Evolving Creatives with Clicks (ECC), which reformulates creative optimization as fine-grained editing rather than generation from scratch. ECC selectively refines attributes that hurt CTR while preserving those that contribute positively. Specifically, faced with a rich attribute space across massive images, ECC first identifies 28 attributes significantly correlated with CTR via ANOVA and Random Forest regression. Based on attribute contrasts between images with disparate CTRs, we instruction-tune a prompt model to generate editing suggestions, then refine it with real click preferences since reference-derived suggestions are not uniformly beneficial. Furthermore, we introduce Consistent Preference Optimization (CPO) as ECC's preference optimization strategy, which enforces consistency across semantically equivalent shuffled suggestions to mitigate DPO overfitting and improve preference generalization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ECC significantly improves the CTR of ad images, outperforming state-of-the-art models by a substantial margin. The complete data pipeline, including attribute extraction and analysis, the resulting dataset, and source code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECC 框架，将电商广告创意优化重构为细粒度属性编辑而非整体生成，通过筛选与 CTR 显著相关的属性、基于对比的指令微调与真实点击偏好优化，并引入 Consistent Preference Optimization 缓解 DPO 过拟合，显著提升广告图 CTR。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 CTR 奖励信号的方法对表现不佳图像中的所有属性施加同等惩罚，忽略了部分属性其实对点击有益，导致优化不精确。
AI.method: ECC 先用 ANOVA 与随机森林回归从海量图像中筛选出 28 个与 CTR 显著相关的属性；再依据高/低 CTR 图像的属性对比指令微调提示模型以生成编辑建议，并用真实点击偏好进一步精修；同时提出 Consistent Preference Optimization（CPO），通过对语义等价的重排建议施加一致性约束，缓解 DPO 过拟合并提升偏好泛化。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 ECC 显著提升广告图 CTR，并大幅超越当前最优模型。
AI.conclusion: 将创意优化建模为细粒度选择性编辑，并结合真实点击偏好与一致性偏好优化，是提升电商广告图点击效果的有效路径；完整数据流程、数据集与源码将在录用后公开。

title: AV-FlowEdit: Training-Free Prompt-Driven Audio-Visual Editing with Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation
summary: Joint audio-video diffusion models generate synchronized content, but editing existing clips requires target changes without disrupting non-target structure or cross-modal correspondence. We present AV-FlowEdit, a training-free and inversion-free framework for prompt-driven audio-video editing. Our key insight is that source--target flow differences provide both cross-modal editing directions and preservation cues. Under shared perturbations, they jointly update the video and audio branches, supporting visual-only, audio-only, and joint edits while retaining pretrained cross-modal interactions. To suppress drift accumulated during sampling, Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation combines flow saliency, aligned audio activity, multiscale low-frequency displacement, and diffusion-stage scheduling. This adaptively preserves unsupported regions while allowing intended audio-visual events. AV-FlowEdit requires no model training, external masks, or optimization-based inversion. Experiments show strong prompt alignment and temporal consistency, together with competitive audio quality and cross-modal coherence.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、免反演的音频-视频编辑框架 AV-FlowEdit，利用源-目标流差异同时提供跨模态编辑方向与保持线索，并通过跨模态事件感知谱轨迹保持机制抑制采样漂移，实现视觉、音频及联合编辑。
AI.motivation: 联合音视频扩散模型可生成同步内容，但编辑已有片段时需实现目标修改，同时不破坏非目标结构与跨模态对应关系，现有方法通常依赖训练、外部掩码或优化式反演，成本高且易损伤跨模态一致性。
AI.method: 核心洞察是源-目标流差异既给出跨模态编辑方向，也提供保持线索；在共享扰动下联合更新视频与音频分支，支持纯视觉、纯音频和联合编辑，并保留预训练跨模态交互。为抑制采样累积漂移，提出 Cross-Modal Event-Aware Spectral Trajectory Preservation，融合流显著性、对齐音频活动、多尺度低频位移与扩散阶段调度，自适应保持无支撑区域并允许目标音视频事件。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法具有强提示对齐性与时间一致性，并在音频质量和跨模态连贯性上具备竞争力，且无需模型训练、外部掩码或基于优化的反演。
AI.conclusion: AV-FlowEdit 为提示驱动的音视频编辑提供了免训练、免反演的可行范式，通过流差异引导与谱轨迹保持机制，在多种编辑模式下兼顾编辑效果与跨模态一致性。

title: Volume Rendering with Metric--Phase Fields for Thin Structures and Sign-Ambiguous Geometry
summary: Neural implicit surface methods that couple volume rendering with signed distance functions (SDFs), such as VolSDF and NeuS, achieve high-quality multi-view reconstruction for watertight objects. However, these approaches rely on a globally consistent inside-outside partition of space. This assumption becomes fragile for thin structures (e.g., sheets, tubes, and thin walls) and can break down for sign-ambiguous geometry (e.g., surfaces with boundary, non-manifold junctions, and closely spaced surface components), often resulting in spurious closures or loss of fine structures. Unsigned distance field (UDF) formulations relax the global sign requirement and better support non-watertight geometry, but are substantially harder to optimize. We propose PhaseSurf, a neural volume rendering framework built on Metric-Phase Fields (MPFs). MPFs decompose geometry into a nonnegative metric field capturing unsigned proximity and a continuous phase field providing a soft sign cue. By coupling the two through residual phase injection, MPFs yield a signed composite implicit function with stable near-surface gradients while retaining UDF-like robustness in sign-ambiguous regions. This design enables direct iso-surface extraction using standard Marching Cubes and avoids the failure modes of both pure SDF- and UDF-based formulations. We further introduce MPF-specific training losses that enforce metric consistency, stabilize phase transitions near the interface, and suppress spurious geometry in free space. Experiments on multi-view datasets with thin structures and sign-ambiguous geometry show that PhaseSurf produces more stable reconstructions and higher-quality geometry than UDF-based methods and recent 3DGS pipelines, while avoiding artifacts typical of SDF-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出PhaseSurf，基于度量-相位场（MPF）的神经体渲染框架，将几何分解为非负度量场与连续相位场并耦合为带符号复合隐函数，兼顾SDF近表面梯度稳定与UDF对符号歧义几何的鲁棒性，可用Marching Cubes直接提取等值面。
AI.motivation: 现有耦合体渲染与SDF的方法（如VolSDF、NeuS）依赖全局一致的"内外"空间划分，对薄结构（片、管、薄壁）易失效，对符号歧义几何（带边界曲面、非流形连接、近邻表面组件）会产生虚假闭合或丢失细节；纯UDF方案虽放宽全局符号要求、更适合非水密几何，但优化难度大。因此需要一种兼具两者优势的表示。
AI.method: 提出Metric-Phase Fields（MPF）：将几何分解为非负度量场（表达无符号邻近度）与连续相位场（提供软符号线索），通过残差相位注入耦合二者，得到带符号的复合隐函数，在近表面保持稳定梯度，同时在符号歧义区域保留类UDF鲁棒性。并设计MPF专属训练损失：约束度量一致性、稳定界面附近相位过渡、抑制自由空间中的伪几何。
AI.result: 在包含薄结构与符号歧义几何的多视图数据集上，PhaseSurf的重建比UDF类方法和近期3DGS流程更稳定、几何质量更高，同时避免了SDF类方法常见的伪影。
AI.conclusion: MPF表示通过度量场与相位场的残差耦合，统一了SDF与UDF的优势，可在无需全局符号假设的前提下获得稳定的带符号隐式面，并支持标准Marching Cubes直接提取等值面，为薄结构与非水密、符号歧义几何的神经重建提供了有效方案。

title: Stochastic Finite-Transition Learning and Exploration for Accelerated MRI Reconstruction
summary: Generative MRI reconstruction maps an initial source distribution to the target image distribution along a learned recovery trajectory. Common generative methods, such as diffusion and flow, typically learn fine-grained local dynamics whose integration defines this global mapping, hence requiring many network evaluations at inference. Existing few-step sampling approaches can lower computational burden by approximating large transformations from local dynamics, albeit at the expense of reconstruction fidelity. FLEX-MRI instead partitions recovery into a small number of finite intervals between retained states defined by progressive changes in k-space support, and directly learns the reconstruction change across each interval. Because such finite transitions can admit multiple plausible outcomes, FLEX-MRI combines support-relaxed finite-transition learning with stochastic exploration. During training, randomized k-space sampling masks define finite-transition targets with varying support, while the prediction loss remains unrestricted by each individual mask. At inference, FLEX-MRI perturbs a random subset of currently estimated k-space coefficients, allowing the learned predictor to stochastically explore alternative transition paths. Each predicted state is then reconciled with the acquired measurements through data consistency. We theoretically show that this stochastic exploration induces nonzero transition-level variation through the learned recovery map and data consistency without requiring an auxiliary generative sampler. Experiments on multi-coil MRI datasets show that FLEX-MRI outperforms competing methods while maintaining computational efficiency comparable to few-step baselines.

AI.tldr: FLEX-MRI 将 MRI 重建分解为基于 k 空间支撑渐进变化的少量有限区间，直接学习区间间的重建变化，并结合支撑松弛的有限转移学习与随机探索，实现高效且高保真的生成式重建。
AI.motivation: 常见生成式方法（如扩散与流模型）学习细粒度局部动力学，需多次网络评估，推理开销大；现有少步采样方法虽降低计算量，却牺牲重建保真度。因此需要一个兼顾效率与保真度的少步生成式重建框架。
AI.method: FLEX-MRI 按 k 空间支撑的渐进变化，将恢复过程划分为少量有限区间，并直接学习每个区间内的重建变化。由于有限转移可能对应多种合理结果，方法结合支撑松弛的有限转移学习与随机探索：训练时用随机 k 空间采样掩码定义不同支撑的有限转移目标，且预测损失不受单个掩码限制；推理时扰动当前估计 k 空间系数的随机子集，使预测器随机探索替代转移路径，并通过数据一致性将每个预测状态与采集测量对齐。
AI.result: 理论证明该随机探索在无需辅助生成采样器的情况下，通过学习到的恢复映射与数据一致性产生非零的转移级变化。在多线圈 MRI 数据集上，FLEX-MRI 优于竞争方法，同时保持与少步基线相当的计算效率。
AI.conclusion: FLEX-MRI 通过有限转移学习与随机探索，在少步设置下实现了优于现有方法的重建性能，并保持高效计算，为生成式 MRI 重建提供了兼顾保真度与效率的替代范式。

title: From 2.1M Hours of Raw Broadcast Audio to Finnish Speech SSL: Confidence Filtering and Architectural Analysis at Scale
summary: Broadcast archives offer scale and diversity for self-supervised learning (SSL) but contain substantial noisy, non-speech, and multilingual content. Prior work typically relies on voice activity detection or language identification (LID) to extract speech, ensuring presence rather than quality. Whether and how to filter unlabeled speech by quality for SSL, particularly from noisy broadcasts, remains underexplored. We present a large-scale Finnish SSL study starting from 2.1M hours of unconstrained broadcast audio. We propose automatic speech recognition (ASR) confidence as a proxy for pretraining data quality and show 3-7% relative WER improvements over LID-based filtering despite a smaller training set. We further address the lack of controlled architectural comparisons in speech SSL by evaluating Transformer, Macaron-Net, Conformer, and E-Branchformer at matched parameter budgets. Our models improve upon prior Finnish SSL baselines, particularly at Base scale and out-of-domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于 ASR 置信度的预训练数据质量筛选方法，在大规模芬兰语广播音频自监督学习中优于 LID 筛选，并系统比较了多种语音 SSL 架构。
AI.motivation: 广播档案为自监督学习提供规模与多样性，但包含大量噪声、非语音及多语种内容。已有工作多依赖 VAD 或 LID 仅保证语音的存在性而非质量，如何按质量筛选无标注语音（尤其噪声广播场景）仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 从 210 万小时无约束广播音频出发，提出以自动语音识别（ASR）置信度作为预训练数据质量的代理指标进行筛选；并在匹配参数量下对 Transformer、Macaron-Net、Conformer 和 E-Branchformer 进行受控架构比较。
AI.result: 尽管训练集更小，基于 ASR 置信度的筛选相比基于 LID 的筛选取得 3-7% 的相对 WER 改善；所得模型在 Base 规模和域外场景下优于已有的芬兰语 SSL 基线。
AI.conclusion: ASR 置信度是有效的预训练数据质量代理，可用于噪声广播语音的 SSL 数据筛选；同时为语音 SSL 提供了受控的架构对比结果。

title: Robust Vision-Language Navigation with Awareness of Instruction-Execution Progress
summary: In Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) tasks involving multi-step instructions as guidance, an agent must associate its observations with the relevant instruction content at each decision point. Most graph-based methods commonly match candidate trajectories with the entire instruction, allowing already executed content to interfere with subsequent decisions. Although instruction-execution progress provides a direct cue for separating executed and pending content, existing progress estimation approaches often rely on explicit progress supervision, sophisticated progress-learning stages, or costly online reasoning with LLMs. In this paper, we propose a robust VLN framework with Awareness of Instruction-Execution Progress (VLN-AIEP), which couples progress estimation with navigation decision-making. VLN-AIEP associates the visited trajectory with the instruction to suppress embeddings corresponding to executed content, and then matches candidate locations with the pending content. This coupling makes correct navigation decisions depend on accurate progress estimation, allowing the progress estimator to learn directly from navigation decision labels without explicit progress annotations. To support progress estimation, we construct a landmark-anchored trajectory representation that encodes the semantic labels and viewpoint-relative geometry of instruction-referred landmarks. These landmarks serve as spatial references for associating the visited trajectory with executed instruction content. Extensive experiments on R2R, RxR, CVDN, and R2R-CE demonstrate that the proposed method achieves favorable performance across multiple metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出VLN-AIEP框架，将指令执行进度估计与导航决策耦合，无需显式进度标注即可抑制已执行指令内容的干扰，在R2R、RxR、CVDN、R2R-CE上取得良好性能。
AI.motivation: 在基于多步指令的视觉语言导航任务中，智能体需在每步决策时把观测与相关指令内容对应。现有图方法通常将候选轨迹与整条指令匹配，已执行内容会干扰后续决策。指令执行进度可区分已执行与待执行内容，但已有进度估计方法依赖显式监督、复杂学习阶段或昂贵的LLM在线推理，因此需要一种更简洁鲁棒的方案。
AI.method: 提出VLN-AIEP框架，将进度估计与导航决策耦合：先把已访问轨迹与指令关联以抑制已执行内容的嵌入表示，再将候选位置与待执行内容匹配。该耦合使正确导航决策依赖准确的进度估计，从而让进度估计器直接从导航决策标签中学习，无需显式进度标注。同时构建地标锚定的轨迹表示，编码指令所指地标的语义标签与视点相对几何关系，作为关联已访问轨迹与已执行指令内容的空间参照。
AI.result: 在R2R、RxR、CVDN和R2R-CE四个数据集上的大量实验表明，该方法在多项指标上均取得较优性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过将指令执行进度感知与导航决策耦合，并借助地标锚定的轨迹表示，可在无需显式进度监督或在线LLM推理的情况下有效缓解已执行指令内容的干扰，提升多步指令VLN任务的性能。

title: What Do Visual-Head Discovery Scores Actually Find? Attention Source, Necessity, and Random-Control Pitfalls in Vision-Language Models
summary: Attention heads that attend to image regions relevant to a question are increasingly used to steer, ground and interpret vision-language models (VLMs) and to reduce their hallucinations. They are mostly found by ranking heads with an attention- pattern score and validated by steering or masking them. We ask how the choices inside such a discovery score shape the heads it returns, and which of the two validations identifies them. On Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct we vary the query type, the discovery corpus and the token positions whose attention is read (the attention source) in a full 2 x 3 x 2 design, and test all 12 head-sets for steerability (CERS: Contrastive Evidence-Region Steering score) and necessity (NCS: Necessity Con- trast Score) against layer-matched random head-sets. (1) The attention source and the query type reshape the selected heads far more than the corpus: changing the source keeps a median of 49 of the top-100 heads, the query 55 and the cor- pus 84, while two halves of the same data share 96-99. (2) Necessity follows the attention source: head-sets discovered from query-span attention are more nec- essary than last-token ones (difference 0.083, p=6 x 10^-10), and the two re- ferring + query-span sets lie 17-19 standard deviations above 250 layer-matched random sets (Holm-adjusted p=0.048). The referring + query-span effect re- plicates on several recent VLMs. (3) Steerability is not specific to the discovered heads: no discovered head-set steers better than its layer-matched random sets (rank p >= 0.14), and random sets drawn from the same or from any layer span the discovered sets' scores. Necessity therefore separates the discovery settings, while steering at this strength does not. We turn these findings into a protocol for reporting visual-head discoveries.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上系统操控视觉注意力头"发现分数"的查询类型、发现语料与注意力来源三个要素，检验所发现头集合的可操纵性与必要性，发现注意力来源是决定头选择与必要性的主导因素，而必要性能区分发现设置、可操纵性不能。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型中用于引导、定位与解读的"看图像相关区域的注意力头"日益重要，可用于减少幻觉。但这类头通常仅通过注意力模式分数排序发现，再用引导或掩码来验证，尚不清楚发现分数内部的设计选择如何影响所返回的头，以及哪种验证方式才真正识别它们。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct上采用2×3×2全因子设计，变动查询类型、发现语料与被读取注意力的token位置（注意力来源），并将全部12个头部集合与层匹配的随机头集合进行对比；用CERS（对比证据区域引导分数）检验可操纵性，用NCS（必要性对比分数）检验必要性。
AI.result: (1)注意力来源与查询类型对所选头的影响远大于语料：改变来源时top-100头中位保留49个，查询保留55个，语料保留84个，而同数据两半分共享96–99个。(2)必要性与注意力来源一致：基于查询跨度注意力的头集合比末token集合更具必要性（差0.083，p=6×10^-10），两个指代+查询跨度集合位于250个层匹配随机集合之上17–19个标准差（Holm校正p=0.048），该效应在多个近期VLM上复现。(3)可操纵性对发现头不具特异性：没有任何被发现头集合优于其层匹配随机集合（秩p≥0.14），来自同层或任意层的随机集合都可覆盖其分数区间。
AI.conclusion: 必要性可区分不同的头发现设置，而当前强度下的引导不能；作者据此提出一套用于报告视觉注意力头发现的协议。

title: Replaying the Movie in Your Mind Decoding Dynamic Visual Perception and Recall from EEG
summary: Decoding dynamic visual content from EEG has advanced rapidly for visual perception, yet it remains unclear which aspects of neural representations are preserved when people internally replay dynamic scenes. We introduce PAIR, an EEG benchmark collected from 20 participants using an interleaved, clip-wise paradigm that pairs naturalistic video viewing with immediate visual recall. This design enables a comparison between externally driven perception and internally generated recall for the same stimulus content within a fixed trial sequence. We benchmark multiple decoding models on hierarchical semantic classification at both fine-grained and coarse-grained levels, meta-feature decoding tasks covering motion, color, object number, face, and human presence, and a state-decoding task that discriminates perception from recall. Within-subject validation results show numerically similar performance for several model--task combinations, alongside higher perception accuracy in two coarse-grained comparisons after multiple-comparison correction. In contrast, perception and recall are highly separable at the state level under the present validation protocol. State accuracy remains high after alpha-band ablation, although this does not exclude ocular or other task-related contributions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PAIR——一个20名被试的EEG基准数据集，采用剪辑级交替范式将自然视频观看与即时视觉回忆配对，用于比较外部驱动感知与内部生成回忆的神经表征，并评测多种解码模型在语义分类、元特征解码与感知/回忆状态判别任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 从EEG解码动态视觉内容在视觉感知方面进展迅速，但人们内部重放动态场景时，哪些神经表征方面得以保留仍不清楚。现有研究缺乏对同一刺激内容下感知与回忆的可比性设计。
AI.method: 构建PAIR基准：20名被试，采用交错的、按剪辑划分的范式，将自然视频观看与即时视觉回忆配对，使同一刺激内容的外部驱动感知与内部生成回忆在固定试次序列内可比。评测多类解码模型，涵盖细粒度与粗粒度层级语义分类、覆盖运动、颜色、物体数量、面孔、人物出现的元特征解码任务，以及区分感知与回忆的状态解码任务。
AI.result: 被试内验证显示，若干模型—任务组合的性能在数值上相近；经多重比较校正后，两项粗粒度比较中感知准确率更高。相比之下，在现有验证协议下，感知与回忆在状态层面高度可分；alpha频段消融后状态准确率仍保持较高，但这不能排除眼动或其他任务相关因素的贡献。
AI.conclusion: PAIR为研究感知与回忆中动态视觉内容神经表征的保持与差异提供了可比基准；感知与回忆在语义/元特征层面表现相近，而在状态层面高度可分，提示二者区分可能依赖较稳健的信号成分，但需进一步排除眼动等混杂因素。

title: BenCoDiC: A Large-Scale Contextual Cyberbullying Corpus for Bengali Political News Discourse FULL VERSION
summary: Cyberbullying is a growing concern in online communities, yet existing Bengali corpora remain limited in contextual information, annotation transparency, scale, accessibility, and support for multidimensional analysis, thereby hindering robust detection and comprehensive study of harasser behaviors and networks. To address these gaps, we introduce the Bengali Contextual and Diverse Cyberbullying (\textit{BenCoDiC}) corpus, a publicly available contextual cyberbullying resource for Bengali political news discourse comprising 50,250 textual instances collected from 100 YouTube videos and their associated discussions. The corpus preserves caption--comment--reply relationships and is organized through a nine-dimensional star schema covering users, videos, textual content, context, time, engagement, political parties, target identities, and language categories. Five AI chatbots were initially evaluated for annotation but did not meet the predefined reliability criterion. Consequently, a two-tier human annotation process with expert verification was adopted, achieving Fleiss' $κ=0.86$ and Krippendorff's $α=0.86$. Statistical analyses characterize the corpus, while transformer-based experiments show that incorporating conversational context yields modest but consistent improvements over isolated-text classification. \textit{BenCoDiC} supports context-aware cyberbullying detection and perpetrator-oriented behavioral and network analysis. The corpus is available at https://github.com/bencodic/BenCoDiC-Corpus.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了BenCoDiC——一个公开的孟加拉语情境化网络欺凌语料库，包含50,250条来自100个YouTube政治新闻视频的评论数据，采用九维星型模式组织，经两级人工标注达到Fleiss' κ=0.86与Krippendorff's α=0.86，并验证对话情境对检测有稳定增益。
AI.motivation: 现有孟加拉语网络欺凌语料库在情境信息、标注透明度、规模、可获取性及多维分析支持方面存在局限，阻碍了对欺凌者行为与网络的鲁棒检测及全面研究。
AI.method: 构建BenCoDiC语料库：从100个YouTube孟加拉语政治新闻视频及其讨论中采集50,250条文本实例，保留字幕—评论—回复关系，采用覆盖用户、视频、文本内容、情境、时间、互动、政党、目标身份与语言类别的九维星型模式组织；先评估五个AI聊天机器人标注但未达可靠性标准，改用带专家验证的两级人工标注流程；开展统计分析及基于Transformer的分类实验（对比孤立文本与引入对话情境）。
AI.result: 标注一致性达Fleiss' κ=0.86、Krippendorff's α=0.86；统计分析刻画了语料特征；Transformer实验表明引入对话情境相较孤立文本分类带来适度但一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: BenCoDiC支持情境感知的网络欺凌检测及面向施害者的行为与网络分析，语料库已公开于 https://github.com/bencodic/BenCoDiC-Corpus。

title: GuidedNav: Shaping Vision-Language Navigation Representations through Pre-action Attention and Spatial Guidance
summary: Vision-and-language navigation (VLN) requires an agent to track progress through an extended instruction, identify landmarks relevant to its current objective, and understand the surrounding spatial structure to act. End-to-end navigation policies typically rely on action supervision to implicitly learn these capabilities. Without explicit guidance on the evidence underlying each decision, however, policies can overfit to correlations predictive of training actions rather than learn the task-relevant grounding and geometry needed for generalization. Our insight is to guide the representations that connect instructions to actions: identifying what remains to be done determines which visual evidence matters, while understanding the geometry around that evidence informs how to move. We introduce GuidedNav, a unified framework that explicitly shapes these representations through training-time guidance. Subtask and landmark guidance steer native pre-action attention toward the active instruction segment and relevant visual regions, grounding action prediction in the current objective. Spatial guidance aligns the policy's internal representations with geometric features that capture long-horizon context and local spatial structure. Together, these objectives strengthen navigation capabilities while avoiding the inference overhead of intermediate textual reasoning and online geometric encoding. We also introduce Guided-R2R and Guided-RxR, two annotation-enriched navigation datasets that support more interpretable VLN research. GuidedNav establishes state-of-the-art performance among the compared monocular RGB policies, improving success rates by 8.1% and 13.1% relative to the strongest prior results on R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, respectively, while achieving faster inference. Extensive experiments further demonstrate the effectiveness and real-world transferability of our approach.

AI.tldr: GuidedNav 通过训练时显式引导指令-动作表征（子任务、地标与空间引导），在不增加推理开销的前提下提升视觉语言导航的泛化能力与成功率。
AI.motivation: 端到端 VLN 策略通常仅依赖动作监督隐式学习"追踪指令进度、识别当前目标相关地标、理解空间结构"等能力，缺乏对决策依据的显式指导，易过拟合训练动作的预测性相关性，而非学到任务所需的视觉落地与几何理解，从而损害泛化性。
AI.method: 作者提出 GuidedNav 统一框架，在训练时显式塑造连接指令与动作的表征：1）子任务与地标引导，将原生的动作前注意力（pre-action attention）导向当前活跃指令片段和相关视觉区域；2）空间引导，使策略内部表征与捕捉长时程上下文和局部空间结构的几何特征对齐。此外构建了 Guided-R2R 与 Guided-RxR 两个增强标注数据集。
AI.result: 在单体 RGB 策略对比中达到 SOTA：相比最强先前结果，R2R-CE 与 RxR-CE val-unseen 上的成功率分别相对提升 8.1% 与 13.1%，同时推理速度更快。实验验证了方法的有效性及真实世界可迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 通过训练时引导指令-动作表征，可显式注入任务相关落地与几何信息，强化导航能力且避免中间文本推理与在线几何编码的推理开销，为更可解释的 VLN 研究提供数据支持。

title: Locate, Judge, Read: Role-Specialized Tool Agents over a Knowledge-Point Index for Open-Domain Multimodal Document QA
comment: 17 pages, 3 figures, 11 tables. Code, prompts and benchmark runner: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench
summary: Question answering over large heterogeneous document collections requires first finding the right passages and then reading them, yet current retrieval-augmented agents give one model both kinds of tools and let it schedule itself. We present KnowForge, a pipeline separated by job: a hybrid-retrieval knowledge-point index; a Locator agent that can only search; a code-scheduled bridge judge that forces the missing second hop; a typed, size-bounded evidence pool that merges every search's ranking; a Deep Reader agent that can only read text, images and tables; and a synthesizer with a format checker. With a self-hosted Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (3B active), KnowForge reaches F1 47.5 on the full open-domain M3DocVQA (2,441 questions, 3,368 PDFs), +11.0 over the published M3DocRAG system and +7.1 over one-shot retrieve-and-answer on the same index and model, and 53.5 with DeepSeek-V4-Flash. On MultiHop-RAG it reaches 73.5 accuracy, above the strongest published RAG and GraphRAG results (71.2); on the single-document MMLongBench-Doc it lifts the same model from 34.8 to 47.0, level with GPT-4o reading page images (46.3). Per-job ablations on the full benchmarks attribute the gain: the Deep Reader is worth 3.8, 9.8 and 0 points on the three corpora, tracking how visual each is; merging both agents into one with all tools and twice the rounds loses 1.9 F1 because it keeps searching instead of reading; a round-budget sweep shows a step at four Locator rounds and a plateau beyond; query latency scales with model calls rather than corpus size. We serve the three indexed benchmarks as read-only knowledge bases (free registration) and release all prompts and the runner code: https://github.com/metask-ai/knowforge-bench

AI.tldr: KnowForge 将检索增强问答按职责拆分为"只负责搜索的 Locator"与"只负责阅读的 Deep Reader"两个独立智能体，中间用代码调度的桥接判定桥接证据池，在 M3DocVQA、MultiHop-RAG、MMLongBench-Doc 上以 3B 激活参数取得显著提升，超出同索引同模型的单次检索作答与已发表强基线。
AI.motivation: 大规模异构文档集合问答需先定位正确段落再阅读，而现有检索增强智能体把两类工具交给同一模型自行调度，易出现"继续搜索而不去阅读"的调度偏差。作者希望验证按职责分离（搜索 vs. 阅读）是否能带来系统性收益。
AI.method: 提出 KnowForge 流水线，按职能分工：混合检索构建知识点索引；Locator 智能体只能搜索；由代码调度的桥接判定强制补齐缺失的第二跳；类型化、大小受限的证据池合并每次搜索的排序结果；Deep Reader 智能体只能读取文本、图像与表格；最后由带格式检查器的合成器输出答案。使用自托管 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B（3B 激活）与 DeepSeek-V4-Flash。
AI.result: 在完整开放域 M3DocVQA（2,441 问、3,368 个 PDF）上 F1 达 47.5，较已发表 M3DocRAG 提升 +11.0，较同索引同模型的单次检索作答提升 +7.1；使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash 达 53.5。MultiHop-RAG 准确率 73.5，超过最强已发表 RAG/GraphRAG（71.2）。单文档 MMLongBench-Doc 上把同模型从 34.8 提升至 47.0，与 GPT-4o 读页面图像（46.3）持平。消融显示 Deep Reader 在三语料分别贡献 3.8、9.8、0 分，与语料的视觉化程度一致；将两智能体合并为单智能体并翻倍轮次反而损失 1.9 F1；轮次预算存在四轮 Locator 的台阶后进入平台期；查询延迟随模型调用次数而非语料规模伸缩。
AI.conclusion: 按职责分离检索与阅读、并以代码调度桥接第二跳，可有效缓解智能体"过度搜索、疏于阅读"的问题，在参数规模有限时仍显著提升多模态、多跳与长文档问答性能；收益大小与语料的视觉依赖程度相关，且延迟可控。作者开放三个基准为只读知识库并发布全部提示词与运行代码。

title: Neurograf v1: An End-to-End Romanian-First Language Model Family
summary: We present Neurograf v1, an experimental end-to-end Romanian-first language-model pipeline developed to investigate the feasibility of training language models from scratch for a lower-resource European language. The pipeline comprises RoSfera, a 635 GB Romanian corpus containing 175.7 million documents; an 80k byte-level BPE tokenizer; five decoder-only models ranging from 160M to 6B parameters, trained on 131 billion tokens; three instruction-tuned assistants; and two contrastively trained embedding models. Training and evaluation were conducted using computing infrastructure at ELI-NP/IFIN-HH. The model family exhibits consistent scaling of validation loss and increasing Romanian factual and cultural knowledge with model size. On the 1,000-question WWTBM benchmark, Neurograf-6B achieves 69.89% accuracy on Romanian-context questions, while Neurograf-3.2B reaches 67.38%. Compute-optimal analysis yields a parameter-scaling exponent of approximately 0.423. Neurograf v1 serves as an experimental demonstrator rather than a production system. The study identifies practical challenges involving diacritic preservation, corpus quality, data composition, and tokenization efficiency, while demonstrating the feasibility of developing Romanian-first base models, instruction-following assistants, and semantic embedding models within a unified training pipeline.

AI.tldr: 提出Neurograf v1——一套罗马尼亚语优先的端到端语言模型流水线，验证从零训练低资源欧洲语言模型的可行性，涵盖语料、分词器、5个基础模型（160M–6B）、3个指令助手和2个嵌入模型。
AI.motivation: 探究为低资源欧洲语言（罗马尼亚语）从零训练语言模型的可行性，弥补该类语言在基础模型、指令模型和嵌入模型上的空白。
AI.method: 构建RoSfera语料（635 GB、1.757亿文档）；训练80k字节级BPE分词器；训练5个decoder-only模型（160M–6B参数，1310亿tokens）；构建3个指令微调助手和2个对比学习嵌入模型；使用ELI-NP/IFIN-HH计算设施进行训练与评估。
AI.result: 模型家族呈现一致的验证损失缩放规律，罗马尼亚语事实与文化知识随规模增长；在1000题WWTBM基准上，Neurograf-6B在罗马尼亚语语境题上达69.89%，Neurograf-3.2B达67.38%；算力最优分析得到参数缩放指数约0.423。
AI.conclusion: Neurograf v1是实验性演示系统而非生产系统；识别出变音符号保留、语料质量、数据构成与分词效率等实际挑战，同时证明在统一流水线内开发罗马尼亚语优先基础模型、指令跟随助手与语义嵌入模型的可行性。

title: Measurable Semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting with Joint Region and Depth Supervision for Interactive Building Inspection
summary: Image-based 3D reconstruction provides a scalable representation for building inspection and maintenance. However, photorealistic reconstruction alone does not fully provide the geometric measurability, semantic structure, and interactive information access required for engineering applications. This study proposes a measurable semantic 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) framework with region and depth supervision for interactive building inspection from multi-view imagery. Mask-based region supervision suppresses irrelevant backgrounds and focuses optimization on target regions. Point-wise depth supervision guides Gaussian centers toward physical surfaces using reference geometry derived from multi-view stereo (MVS) point clouds, providing geometric anchors for measuring physical dimensions and areas. A semantic Gaussian field associates learnable class features with individual Gaussian primitives, enabling semantic rendering and component-level inspection. These capabilities are operationalized through AEC-SplatTwin, an interactive building inspection platform supporting real-time visualization, semantic analysis, quantitative measurement, and multimodal large language model (MLLM)-assisted interaction. On the synthetic UAV-inspection QuakeCity and smartphone-captured HKUPB datasets, the framework reduces Gaussian-center depth MAE by 58.1% and 86.8%, while its semantic field achieves mIoU values of 0.8529 and 0.8642. On HKUPB, the mean relative errors for height, width, and area measurements are 0.33%, 1.07%, and 0.60%. These results show that the proposed framework extends 3DGS beyond visual reconstruction into a measurable, semantically structured, and interactive engineering representation for building inspection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种带区域与深度监督的可测量语义3DGS框架，并构建AEC-SplatTwin交互式建筑巡检平台，实现可视化、语义分析、定量测量与MLLM辅助交互。
AI.motivation: 纯照片级真实的3D重建缺乏几何可测性、语义结构与交互式信息获取能力，难以满足建筑巡检与维护等工程应用需求。
AI.method: 在3DGS中引入掩膜区域监督抑制背景并聚焦目标区域；利用MVS点云作为参考几何进行逐点深度监督，将高斯中心约束至物理表面以提供几何锚点；构建语义高斯场，将可学习类别特征绑定到各高斯基元以支持语义渲染与构件级巡检；并通过AEC-SplatTwin平台实现实时可视化、语义分析与定量测量及MLLM辅助交互。
AI.result: 在合成UAV巡检数据集QuakeCity与智能手机采集数据集HKUPB上，高斯中心深度MAE分别降低58.1%与86.8%，语义场mIoU达0.8529与0.8642；HKUPB上高度、宽度与面积测量的平均相对误差分别为0.33%、1.07%与0.60%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将3DGS从视觉重建拓展为可测量、语义结构化且可交互的工程表征，服务于建筑巡检应用。

title: Les Misérables Dialogue: A film-based network representation of social communication
summary: In this work, we revisit the classic Les Misérables benchmark network from the perspective of social communication. Using the 1998 film adaptation of the novel, we construct the publicly available Les Misérables Dialogue temporal text network, which explicitly distinguishes speakers, addressees, and other recipients of each utterance, along with its content and timing. Using the ten social dimensions model, we also derive multilayer network representations of the network, in which layers correspond to distinct relational dimensions. Beyond the network dataset, this work offers a general methodology for building similarly rich communication datasets from similar narrative sources.

AI.tldr: 本文从社会传播视角重新审视经典《悲惨世界》基准网络，基于1998年电影改编版构建了公开可用的《悲惨世界》对话时序文本网络，明确区分说话者、受话者与其他受话者及其内容与时间，并利用十维社会模型导出多层网络表示。
AI.motivation: 经典Les Misérables基准网络长期被使用，但缺乏从社会传播与对话互动角度的细粒度刻画；作者希望补充显式区分说话者与受话者、包含内容与时序信息的更丰富对话网络数据，并推广可复用的数据集构建方法。
AI.method: 使用1998年《悲惨世界》电影改编版，抽取每句话语的说话者、受话者和其他受话者，以及话语内容与时间，构建对话时序文本网络；再依据十维社会维度模型，将该网络转化为层对应不同关系维度的多层网络表示。
AI.result: 产出公开可用的Les Misérables Dialogue temporal text network，并提供基于十维社会模型的多层网络表示；此外给出一套从同类叙事来源构建类似丰富传播数据集的通用方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作既扩展了经典基准网络，又提供了对话时序文本网络与多层社会维度表示，并为从叙事文本构建传播数据集提供了可推广的方法论。

title: From Glance to Focus: Mitigating Recognition Laziness in MLLMs for Fine-Grained Recognition
comment: 21 pages, 18 figures, 5 tables. Includes supplementary material
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) generally fall short of expectations in Fine-Grained Visual Recognition (FGVR), although they exhibit promising FGVR foundations, i.e., visual perception and broad category knowledge. Most existing studies seek to remedy this deficiency by adopting domain-specific post-training, at the risk of compromising generalization to unseen domains. Different from these efforts, in this paper, we revisit the FGVR mechanism underlying MLLMs from both the empirical and theoretical perspectives and uncover an inference-time phenomenon termed FGVR Laziness. In brief, FGVR Laziness refers to the insufficient association between visual cues and category concepts under certain candidate category lists and recognition guidance, leaving the FGVR foundations of MLLMs largely under-utilized. To mitigate FGVR Laziness, we propose Laziness-resIstant Visual rEcognition (LIVE), a training-free framework which jointly refines candidate lists and recognition guidance to elicit the latent FGVR capability of MLLMs. Specifically, LIVE first performs query-adaptive candidate inference to derive a compact yet reliable candidate list. Meanwhile, LIVE constructs category-specific FGVR skills by mining the intra-category characteristics and inter-category differences. Finally, LIVE selectively invokes detailed skill guidance according to recognition uncertainty and category confusion, shifting MLLM-based FGVR from a cursory glance to a focus on associating discriminative visual cues with category concepts. Extensive experiments on 13 benchmarks against 24 state-of-the-art methods spanning fine-grained category recognition, action recognition, and general category recognition, verify the effectiveness and generalizability of LIVE across different MLLM backbones. The code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文发现MLLMs在细粒度视觉识别中存在"FGVR Laziness"推理时现象，并提出免训练的LIVE框架，通过联合优化候选类别列表与识别引导来激发MLLMs潜在细粒度识别能力，在13个基准上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: MLLMs在细粒度视觉识别（FGVR）上表现不及预期，尽管其具备有潜力的FGVR基础（如视觉感知与广泛类别知识）。现有研究多采用领域特定的后训练来弥补不足，但存在损害对未见域泛化能力的风险。本文希望从经验与理论双重视角重新审视MLLMs内在的FGVR机制，探索无需训练的改进途径。
AI.method: 作者提出并刻画了"FGVR Laziness"推理时现象，即在特定候选类别列表与识别引导下，视觉线索与类别概念之间的关联不足，导致MLLMs的FGVR基础未被充分利用。为此提出LIVE（Laziness-resIstant Visual rEcognition），一个免训练框架，包含三部分：1）查询自适应的候选推断，生成紧凑且可靠的候选列表；2）通过挖掘类内特征与类间差异构建类别特定的FGVR技能；3）根据识别不确定性与类别混淆，选择性调用详细技能引导，使MLLM从粗略扫视转向聚焦将判别性视觉线索与类别概念关联。
AI.result: 在13个基准上、与24种最先进方法对比，涵盖细粒度类别识别、动作识别与通用类别识别；实验验证了LIVE的有效性与泛化性，且在多种MLLM骨干上均适用。
AI.conclusion: LIVE作为免训练框架，通过缓解FGVR Laziness有效激发MLLMs潜在细粒度识别能力，克服了领域特定后训练的泛化性缺陷，具有跨骨干、跨任务的良好泛化性。代码将在论文接收后发布。

title: SOAR: Source-Aware Reinforcement Learning with Precise Credit Assignment for Search Agents
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for search agents often suffers from evidence fabrication, a failure mode where agents bypass external information ($E_{ext}$) and fabricate an incorrect answer. We argue that this fabrication arises from an over-reliance on unreliable internal knowledge ($E_{int}$) as shortcuts due to the inherent opacity of reasoning trajectories. To address this, we propose SOAR (SOurce-Aware Reinforcement learning), a paradigm that transforms monolithic reasoning into source-explicit trajectories. SOAR (i) disentangles $E_{ext}$ and $E_{int}$ into parallel, observable streams via a Source-Aware Workflow, and (ii) incorporates Source-Consistent Reward to guide the policy evolution. By making information-source attribution explicit, SOAR enables precise credit assignment between different knowledge streams. Evaluations show that SOAR outperforms baselines on 3B and 7B backbones by 7.3% and 5.4%, while reducing evidence fabrication by 74.8%. These confirm that SOAR significantly improves performance on knowledge-intensive benchmarks while effectively mitigating evidence fabrication, fostering more faithful and grounded reasoning with enhanced robustness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SOAR（来源感知强化学习），将单块推理拆分为外部信息与内部知识两条可观测流，并引入来源一致性奖励，抑制证据捏造。在 3B/7B 模型上分别提升 7.3% 和 5.4%，证据捏造降低 74.8%。
AI.motivation: 搜索智能体的强化学习存在"证据捏造"问题：智能体绕过外部信息 E_ext，直接编造错误答案。作者认为其根源在于推理轨迹不透明，导致策略过度依赖不可靠的内部知识 E_int 作为捷径。因此需要让信息来源显式化，以实现精确的信用分配。
AI.method: SOAR 包含两部分：(i) 来源感知工作流（Source-Aware Workflow），将 E_ext 与 E_int 解耦为并行且可观测的两条信息流；(ii) 来源一致性奖励（Source-Consistent Reward），用于引导策略演化。通过显式标注信息来源归属，实现两条知识流之间的精确信用分配。
AI.result: 在 3B 与 7B 骨干模型上，SOAR 相较基线分别提升 7.3% 与 5.4%，同时将证据捏造减少 74.8%。
AI.conclusion: SOAR 在知识密集型基准上显著提升性能，并有效缓解证据捏造，促使推理更加忠实、有据可依，鲁棒性更强。

title: Scaling Agentic Data for Long-Horizon Terminal Intelligence
summary: Terminal agents are moving beyond local operations toward completing real-world professional tasks. Short trajectories can demonstrate commands and tool calls, but they do not fully show how agents accumulate evidence through exploration, use it to inform judgments, continually adjust strategies based on feedback, and turn intermediate results into final deliverables. High-quality long-horizon trajectories capture these agentic behavioral patterns and their connections within a single problem-solving process, providing richer experience for sustained autonomous work. However, environment synthesis may complete or simplify the key work underlying these patterns in advance and thus remove the need for exploration, implementation, and verification that the agent was meant to perform. To address this, we introduce TerminalHorizon, a fully automated data synthesis engine for long-horizon terminal agents. Starting from real-world professional work, it uses independent execution to identify key work omitted during construction and uses the resulting evidence to guide environment reconstruction. To extend these patterns across stages, it progressively expands tasks under the same goal, introducing new requirements that build on prior results and call for further exploration and improvement. Using this engine, we construct 1.5K task environments and perform supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5-27B on the resulting dataset to obtain TerminalHorizon-27B. We achieve substantial performance gains on all 12 benchmarks spanning coding-agent tasks, agentic tasks in real-world production settings, and general reasoning. Multiple RSI case studies, each with a 12-hour research budget, further demonstrate the model's ability to continue experimenting beyond an initial solution, improve its methods based on feedback, and retain effective improvements in its final deliverables.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 TerminalHorizon——一个全自动的长时程终端智能体数据合成引擎，从真实专业工作出发，通过独立执行识别被省略的关键工作并据此重建环境，再以同一目标下渐进扩展任务的方式生成长时程轨迹；基于1.5K任务环境对 Qwen3.5-27B 进行监督微调得到 TerminalHorizon-27B，在12个基准上取得显著提升，并通过12小时预算的 RSI 案例验证其持续实验与改进能力。
AI.motivation: 现有终端智能体研究多聚焦局部操作，短轨迹虽能展示命令与工具调用，却无法体现长时程自主工作中探索、证据积累、依据反馈调整策略并将中间结果转化为最终交付物的关键行为模式。而环境合成往往预先完成或简化了这些模式背后的关键工作，从而抹除了智能体本应进行的探索、实现与验证环节，导致合成的长时程数据缺乏真实的行为连贯性与经验价值。
AI.method: 提出 TerminalHorizon 全自动数据合成引擎：(1) 以真实专业工作为起点，通过独立执行识别环境构建过程中被省略的关键工作，并以所得证据指导环境重建；(2) 在同一目标下渐进式扩展任务，引入基于既有结果的新需求，要求进一步的探索与改进，从而将行为模式跨阶段延展。基于该引擎构建 1.5K 任务环境，并据此对 Qwen3.5-27B 进行监督微调，得到 TerminalHorizon-27B。
AI.result: 在涵盖编码智能体任务、真实生产环境中的智能体任务以及通用推理的共12个基准上均取得显著性能提升；多项预算为12小时的 RSI 案例研究表明，模型能够在初始方案之外持续实验、依据反馈改进方法，并在最终交付物中保留有效的改进。
AI.conclusion: 高质量长时程轨迹能够捕捉智能体的行为模式及其在单一问题求解过程中的内在关联。通过独立执行识别被省略的关键工作并据此重建环境、再以渐进式任务扩展延展行为模式，可有效合成具备真实探索—验证闭环的长时程数据，从而显著提升终端智能体的持续自主工作能力。

title: PreSTO: Predictive Subtree Prefetching for Fast LLM Power Sampling
summary: Power sampling improves large language model (LLM) reasoning at test time by sampling from a sharpened version of the base model's distribution. Its sampler, PowerMH, is slow because its Metropolis--Hastings (MH) updates are sequential: each accept/reject decision sets the state from which the next proposal is generated. Prior work reduces this cost by changing the sampler or the model (e.g., sequential Monte Carlo, approximate lookahead, distillation). We propose Predictive SubTree Prefetching (PreSTO), which accelerates PowerMH by prefetching future proposals and provably leaves its MH transition kernel unchanged. PreSTO views future MH outcomes as a tree of accept/reject decisions: in each model call, it generates the proposals of a \textit{prefetched subtree} of this tree in one batch, then follows the realized path with the original MH acceptance rule. We also observe that MH reaches only a sparse, nearly unary part of each prefetched subtree, we further design a \textit{predictive traversal rule} that chooses the subtree to maximize the predicted number of completed transitions. Across seven datasets and five base LLMs, PreSTO achieves median speedups of $1.71\times$, $1.91\times$, and $2.33\times$ on PowerMH and its follow-ups EntropyCut and MultiTryMH, respectively; on the first two, it makes a median of $3.9\times$ fewer model calls, each only $2.1\times$ longer. On LCB V6 with Qwen3.5-9B, the predictive traversal rule is a further $1.25\times$--$1.37\times$ faster than the default breadth-first traversal.
