The learned policy also generalizes to unseen visual conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出LAPT-Scale可扩展潜在动作预训练范式，利用大规模第一视角人类视频为机器人VLA策略提供类动作监督，在23.3K小时数据上训练，将真实机器人成功率从63.3%提升至85.0%。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略的扩展受限于具身交互数据采集的高昂成本；大规模第一视角人类视频是丰富替代来源，但缺乏机器人动作标签，且现有动作标注方法在真实世界视觉复杂性与多样化操作动力学下噪声较大。
AI.method: LAPT-Scale包含两部分：LAPT-Scale-LAM通过解释人类视频中帧到帧的视觉转换学习连续潜在动作，作为人类-derived监督信号，区别于以往矢量量化LAM，采用连续潜在空间以保留细粒度运动与交互动力学，并结合感知、语义与光流对齐信号改进转换级监督；LAPT-Scale-Policy则通过人类视频潜在动作预训练、目标机器人具身对齐与任务特定后训练来训练VLA策略。
AI.result: 在23.3K小时第一视角视频上训练LAPT-Scale-LAM，为策略预训练提供隐式动作监督，带来一致的扩展增益：标注人类视频规模从1K增至5K小时时，真实机器人成功率由63.3%提升至85.0%；所学策略亦能泛化至未见视觉条件。
AI.conclusion: LAPT-Scale验证了以连续潜在动作从大规模人类视频中提取隐式动作监督的可行性，实现了策略预训练的可扩展增益与跨视觉条件泛化，为降低机器人数据依赖提供有效路径。

title: KVeil: First-Place Solution to ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos
comment: Technical report for the winning solution (1st place, both phases) of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos against Diffusion-based Customization
summary: The rapid development of personalized video generation has raised serious concerns over identity privacy, as a few facial videos of a person now suffice to reproduce their identity in synthetic videos. This report presents the first-place solutions to both phases of the ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP Challenge on Unlearnable Videos, which aims to protect facial videos from unauthorized customization under a limited and imperceptible perturbation budget. For Phase 1, we introduce Reference Capacity Collapse, a pair of complementary losses that degrade the information carried by the reference condition while keeping subsequent video representations dependent on it, together with a Motion-Guided EOT mechanism that improves robustness across unknown inference conditions. Phase 2 further considers tuning-based customization and unseen generative models. To address both threats within a single perturbation, we design a two-layer framework that protects the facial and background regions separately, constructing structure-aligned perturbations from a synthetic target identity in the former and strengthening the white-box disruption of Phase 1 in the latter. Our method achieves nearly perfect protection under white-box reference-based customization, and remains effective under other customization paradigms, various models, and temporal attacks. Both solutions are built upon our recent work LETHE. We hope our solutions can inspire future work on protecting facial videos against unauthorized customization. Our code is available at https://github.com/AntigoneRandy/KVeil.

AI.tldr: 该报告提出ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP"不可学习视频"挑战赛两个阶段的第一名方案，旨在以有限且不可察觉的扰动保护人脸视频免遭未授权定制。方案基于LETHE，Phase 1用参考容量坍缩损失与运动引导EOT，Phase 2用双层框架分别保护人脸与背景。白盒下近乎完美，且跨范式、跨模型、抗时序攻击有效。
AI.motivation: 个性化视频生成快速发展，几段人脸视频即可复现个人身份，带来严重身份隐私风险。挑战赛要求在有限且不可察觉的扰动预算下，保护人脸视频不被未授权定制，需同时应对基于参考的定制与基于微调的定制以及未知生成模型。
AI.method: Phase 1提出参考容量坍缩（Reference Capacity Collapse），由一对互补损失组成：降低参考条件所携带的信息，同时保持后续视频表示仍依赖该参考；并引入运动引导EOT机制，提升在未知推理条件下的鲁棒性。Phase 2针对微调式定制与未见生成模型，设计双层框架，分别保护人脸与背景区域：前者基于合成目标身份构建结构对齐扰动，后者强化Phase 1的白盒破坏。两方案均构建于LETHE之上。
AI.result: 在白盒基于参考的定制下实现近乎完美的保护，并在其他定制范式、多种模型及时间攻击下依然有效。两阶段方案均获ECCV 2026 LifeGenIP不可学习视频挑战赛第一名。
AI.conclusion: 该工作验证了在受限不可察觉扰动下保护人脸视频免受未授权定制的可行性，期望启发后续研究。代码已开源于https://github.com/AntigoneRandy/KVeil。

title: A Privileged Teacher That Only Scores Cannot Search: Critique-Conditioned On-Policy Self-Distillation for Reasoning
comment: Accepted as an oral at the FLLMPT workshop, NeurIPS 2026
summary: On-policy self-distillation promises to replace the sparse outcome signal of verifiable-reward RL with dense token-level credit: a teacher conditioned on the reference solution scores the student's own rollout, and the resulting distributional shift is distilled back into the policy. We investigate whether this scoring signal actually contains corrective credit. Using gold error spans in student rollouts, we test the two signals consumed by self-distillation objectives, the full-distribution KL and the token log-ratio, for two properties: whether they localize errors and whether they push probability away from erroneous student tokens. They exhibit neither of these properties nor can they reliably distinguish correct from incorrect rollouts within the same problem. We argue that this failure is structural: locating an error in a reasoning trace is itself a search problem, while a scoring teacher is never explicitly asked to perform that search. The same model, with the same privileged information, localizes errors substantially better when allowed to generate a critique. This forms the motivation for \emph{critique-conditioned self-distillation}: first generate a critique of the current rollout, then condition the scoring teacher on that critique. The resulting signal localizes errors, is corrective within error spans, and shifts probability toward tokens that initiate backtracking such as ``Wait'', ``But'', and ``Actually''. We further show that the critique is useful both at test time, where resuming a wrong rollout with the critique in context converts math problems the model cannot solve by sampling, and in cold-start GRPO, where it provides an advantage signal on prompts for which verifiable rewards alone provide none.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑 on-policy 自蒸馏中的"教师打分"信号是否真含纠错信用，实验证明 KL 与 token log-ratio 均不能定位错误、也不能把概率推离错误 token；作者提出"critique-conditioned self-distillation"：先让模型生成对当前 rollout 的批评，再以此批评为条件让教师打分，从而获得可定位、可纠错的密集信号。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励 RL 的结果信号稀疏，on-policy 自蒸馏被寄望用 token 级密集信用替代它。但作者怀疑：以参考解答为条件的打分教师所给出的分布偏移，是否真的承载纠错信用（corrective credit），还是仅仅是无方向的分布扰动。若该假设不成立，则现有自蒸馏目标的理论前提就存在结构性缺陷。
AI.method: 1) 以学生 rollout 中的 gold error span 为检验基准，测试自蒸馏目标所消费的两类信号——全分布 KL 与 token log-ratio——是否满足两个性质：(a) 错误定位性，(b) 在错误 span 内把概率推离错误 token 的纠错性，并检验其能否区分同一问题下正确与错误 rollout。2) 论证失败的结构性原因：在推理链中定位错误本身是一个搜索问题，而打分教师从未被显式要求执行该搜索。3) 提出 critique-conditioned self-distillation：先对当前 rollout 生成 critique，再将打分教师条件于该 critique，形成新的蒸馏信号。4) 在测试时用 critique 续写错误 rollout，并在 cold-start GRPO 中用其作为优势信号。
AI.result: KL 与 token log-ratio 两类信号既不定位错误，也不在错误 span 内产生纠错，且不能可靠区分同一问题下正确与错误的 rollout。相反，同一模型在拥有同样特权信息时，若被允许生成 critique，错误定位能力显著提升。critique 条件下的蒸馏信号能定位错误、在错误 span 内具有纠错性，并把概率推向 "Wait"、"But"、"Actually" 等回溯起始 token。测试时以 critique 为上下文续写错误 rollout，可将模型采样无法解决的数学问题解出；在 cold-start GRPO 中，该信号为可验证奖励无法提供任何优势的 prompt 提供了优势信号。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏式打分的失败是结构性的，而非实现细节：定位推理错误是一种搜索，打分教师未被要求搜索，因而其分布偏移缺乏纠错信用。显式生成 critique 可将打分从"评估"转为"定位+纠错"，使同一模型用同样的特权信息产出有效密集信号。critique-conditioned self-distillation 既可用于测试时的错误续写恢复，也可为冷启动 GRPO 提供稀疏可验证奖励之外的稠密优势，是一条可扩展的路线。

title: Gaussian Splatting with Reflections Guided by What is Seen
summary: While novel view synthesis methods like Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have shown impressive performance on common scenes, they often struggle with capturing view-dependent specular effects, particularly near-field reflections. Existing methods utilize environment maps, which only represent lights from infinity, or environment Gaussians, which rely solely on indirect supervision from reflections, are insufficient for accurately modeling such effects. Here, we propose a framework based on 2D Gaussian Splatting (2DGS) that leverages directly observable environment information in input images. Our approach also integrates a hybrid reflection appearance representation and view-dependent specular modeling. Experiments on public benchmarks and a newly curated near-field reflection dataset demonstrate that our method achieves superior rendering quality and geometric accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出基于2DGS的框架，利用输入图像中直接可见的环境信息，并融合混合反射外观表示与视角相关高光建模，在近场反射场景中实现更优的渲染质量与几何精度。
AI.motivation: NeRF与3DGS在常见场景表现优异，但难以捕捉视角相关的镜面高光，尤其是近场反射。现有方案使用环境贴图（仅能表示无穷远处的光照）或环境高斯（仅依赖反射的间接监督），不足以准确建模此类效果。
AI.method: 基于2D Gaussian Splatting（2DGS）构建框架，直接利用输入图像中可观测的环境信息；同时集成混合式反射外观表示与视角相关的镜面高光建模。
AI.result: 在公开基准数据集以及新构建的近场反射数据集上，方法取得了更高的渲染质量和几何精度。
AI.conclusion: 直接利用可观测环境信息并结合混合反射表示与视角相关高光建模，能有效提升近场反射场景的新视角合成质量与几何精度。

title: Neurons++: A Unified Visual-Stream Framework for Image and Video Reconstruction from fMRI with Neural-to-Visual Interpretability
summary: Decoding visual experience from fMRI is important for understanding human perception and developing brain-computer interfaces. Recent generative decoding methods can reconstruct plausible images and videos, but visual plausibility alone does not ensure that the output is faithfully grounded in brain activity. In this work, we propose Neurons++, a visual-stream fMRI reconstruction framework for both static image and dynamic video reconstruction. Compared with our conference version Neurons, Neurons++ extends the paradigm from video-only reconstruction to visual-stream reconstruction for both images and videos, and replaces parallel task conditioning with serial cortex-inspired decoding. The model first uses image-fMRI pretraining to obtain a stable spatial-semantic initialization, and then performs subject-specific fine-tuning for image and video reconstruction separately. The serial design organizes fMRI-derived representations into explicit spatial, semantic, language-level, and temporal cues. Extensive experiments show that Neurons++ achieves state-of-the-art video reconstruction and competitive image reconstruction across standard benchmarks. Beyond reconstruction fidelity, neural-to-visual analyses indicate that Neurons++ exhibits qualitative directional controllability under neural perturbation, that its fMRI encoder read-out is sensitive to stimulus-relevant cortical features, and that it supports ROI-guided semantic modulation. Code and model weights are available at: https://github.com/xmed-lab/NeuronsPlusPlus.

AI.tldr: Neurons++ 是一个面向视觉流 fMRI 重建的框架，统一支持静态图像与动态视频重建，采用序列化皮层启发解码替代并行任务条件，在标准基准上取得 SOTA 视频重建与有竞争力的图像重建，并展现出神经扰动下的方向可控性、皮层特征敏感性与 ROI 引导的语义调制能力。
AI.motivation: 从 fMRI 解码视觉体验对理解人类感知与开发脑机接口具有重要意义。已有生成式解码方法虽能重建看似合理的图像和视频，但视觉合理性并不保证输出忠实于脑活动，因此需要一种更贴近大脑处理机制、能提升神经忠实度的解码框架。
AI.method: 提出 Neurons++，一个视觉流 fMRI 重建框架。相比会议版本 Neurons，其从仅视频重建扩展到图像与视频的视觉流重建，并将并行任务条件替换为序列化、皮层启发的解码。模型先通过图像-fMRI 预训练获得稳定的空间-语义初始化，再分别针对图像和视频重建进行被试特异微调；序列化设计将 fMRI 表征组织为显式的空间、语义、语言层与时间线索。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，Neurons++ 在标准基准上实现了 SOTA 的视频重建和具竞争力的图像重建。除重建保真度外，神经到视觉分析显示：在神经扰动下具有定性的方向可控性，其 fMRI 编码器读出对刺激相关的皮层特征敏感，并支持 ROI 引导的语义调制。
AI.conclusion: Neurons++ 通过序列化皮层启发解码与分阶段预训练/微调，统一了图像与视频的 fMRI 视觉重建，在保真度与神经可解释性方面均有提升，为脑机接口与感知研究提供了可用工具，代码与模型权重已开源。

title: Beyond Discrimination: Evaluating Probability Calibration in Radiomics-Image Fusion for Renal Cell Carcinoma Classification
comment: 12 pages. 1 figure. Accepted at the 2026 Irish Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Cognitive Science (AICS 2026). Proceedings forthcoming
summary: Reliable probability estimates are important for the clinical interpretation of machine-learning classifiers, yet radiomics--image fusion models for renal cell carcinoma (RCC) are commonly evaluated primarily by discrimination. Using 396 patients from the KiTS23 dataset, we evaluated whether adding radiomics to four image-model families improved probabilistic performance in addition to discrimination. Seventeen individual models and four probability-average ensembles were assessed using discrimination, probability calibration, and proper scoring measures. Across 12 matched image-only versus fusion comparisons, AUC and AP improved in all 12, while Brier score and negative log likelihood (NLL) improved in 11 of 12 and expected calibration error (ECE) in eight of 12. The 3D MedVAE gated-fusion model achieved the strongest overall individual-model profile. Probability averaging across concatenation, cross-attention, and gated fusion produced favourable point estimates across all five primary metrics relative to image-only models in all four families, although paired-bootstrap support was stronger for Brier score and NLL than for ECE. These findings show that radiomics--image fusion can improve probabilistic prediction quality beyond discrimination, while calibration behaviour varies across image architectures and fusion strategies. We show that our proposed probability-average ensemble models improve discrimination and calibration simultaneously across all architectures in the study.

AI.tldr: 该研究基于KiTS23的396例患者，系统评估放射组学-影像融合模型在肾细胞癌分类中的概率性能。结果显示融合在判别力上普遍提升，概率校准改善程度因架构与融合策略而异，概率平均集成可同时改善判别力与校准。
AI.motivation: 可靠的肿瘤概率估计对机器学习分类器的临床解读至关重要，但肾细胞癌（RCC）放射组学-影像融合模型通常仅以判别力（如AUC）作为主要评价指标，缺乏对概率校准与评分规则（proper scoring）的系统评估。研究动机在于检验在判别力之外，加入放射组学特征能否带来概率预测质量的提升。
AI.method: 使用KiTS23数据集中的396例患者，在四类影像模型族（image-model families）基础上比较"仅影像"与"放射组学-影像融合"两类模型。共评估17个单体模型和4个概率平均集成模型，评价维度包括判别力（AUC、AP）、概率校准（ECE）与proper scoring指标（Brier score、NLL）。进行12组匹配的对照比较（image-only vs. fusion），并采用配对bootstrap检验统计显著性。融合策略涵盖拼接（concatenation）、交叉注意力（cross-attention）与门控融合（gated fusion）。
AI.result: 在12组匹配比较中，融合模型的AUC与AP在全部12组中均提升；Brier score与NLL在11/12组改善；ECE在8/12组改善。3D MedVAE门控融合模型取得了最佳的单体模型综合表现。对拼接、交叉注意力与门控融合进行概率平均后，四种模型族中的集成模型在全部五个主要指标上均优于仅影像模型，但配对bootstrap支持在Brier score与NLL上强于ECE，即校准（ECE）改善的统计证据较弱。
AI.conclusion: 放射组学-影像融合能够在判别力之外提升概率预测质量，但校准行为随影像架构与融合策略而变化。所提出的概率平均集成模型在所有架构上同时改善了判别力与校准，表明仅有判别力指标不足以评价RCC融合模型的临床可靠性，概率评估应作为标准评价组成部分。

title: Shortcut Learning in Geospatial Foundation Model Embeddings for Cross-Disaster Damage Assessment
summary: Geospatial foundation models can support disaster damage assessment, but high accuracy on familiar disasters may hide shortcut learning: prediction from event or scene characteristics rather than evidence that transfers to a new disaster. We study embeddings from TerraMind, Prithvi-EO-2.0, DOFA, and DINOv3 on the multi-disaster datasets xView2 and BRIGHT. Holding out an entire disaster, instead of randomly splitting image tiles, reduces mean balanced accuracy from 0.807 to 0.638 on xView2 and from 0.818 to 0.568 on BRIGHT. Four sets of tests examine what information supports prediction: event and acquisition context, before/after image inputs, building count, and correct image pairing. Pre-event images remain predictive, and a classifier given only the annotated number of buildings reaches balanced accuracy of 0.629 and 0.653. Combining before/after features performs best on average on xView2, but does not improve over pre-only features on BRIGHT. Shuffling image pairs within the same disaster and damage class causes modest losses. Motivated by these findings, we test whether feature transformations learned only from training disasters improve generalization to unseen disasters. These transformations improve performance, with supervised contrastive learning performing best on xView2 and PCA on BRIGHT. Our results highlight the importance of evaluation on unseen domains for assessing model robustness and show that simple feature-level transformations can improve generalization. Code and experiments can be found at https://github.com/alishibli97/gfm-shortcut-learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究地理空间基础模型在多灾害损伤评估中的“捷径学习”问题，发现按灾害留出的评估方式会显著降低性能，并证明仅用简单特征级变换即可提升跨未见灾害的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 地理空间基础模型可用于灾害损伤评估，但在熟悉灾害上的高精度可能掩盖捷径学习，即模型依赖事件或场景特征进行预测，而非依赖可迁移到新灾害的证据。因此需要以未见灾害为对象进行稳健性评估。
AI.method: 研究TerraMind、Prithvi-EO-2.0、DOFA和DINOv3的嵌入表示，在xView2与BRIGHT两个多灾种数据集上采用留出整个灾害的评估设置，而非随机划分图像瓦片。通过四组测试分析预测所依赖的信息：事件与获取上下文、灾前/灾后图像输入、建筑数量、图像配对正确性。并测试仅在训练灾害上学习的特征变换（监督对比学习、PCA等）对未见灾害的泛化效果。
AI.result: 留出整个灾害使xView2平均平衡准确率从0.807降至0.638，BRIGHT从0.818降至0.568。灾前图像仍具预测性；仅输入标注建筑数量的分类器达到0.629（xView2）和0.653（BRIGHT）的平衡准确率。灾前+灾后特征组合在xView2上平均最优，但在BRIGHT上未优于仅灾前特征。同一灾害、同一损伤类别内打乱图像配对仅造成轻微损失。仅在训练灾害上学习的特征变换可提升性能，其中监督对比学习在xView2最佳，PCA在BRIGHT最佳。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，基于未见域（留出灾害）的评估对衡量模型稳健性至关重要，简单的特征级变换即可改善跨灾害泛化能力。代码与实验见 https://github.com/alishibli97/gfm-shortcut-learning。

title: Beyond Gate Weights: Decision-Level Interpretation of Radiomics-Image Feature Fusion for RCC Classification
comment: 12 pages, 1 figure. Accepted at the 2026 Irish Conference on Artificial Intelligence and Cognitive Science (AICS 2026). Proceedings forthcoming
summary: Gate coefficients describe how a fusion layer weights intermediate features, but they do not necessarily reflect the magnitude of branch contributions at the classifier output. We investigate this distinction in a fixed 3D MedVAE--radiomics model for clear cell versus non-clear cell renal cell carcinoma classification from contrast-enhanced CT. Because the model uses a linear classification head, the binary decision logit can be decomposed exactly into a gated image term, a direct radiomics term, and a bias. We define effective radiomics dominance as the direct radiomics term's share of the summed absolute non-bias branch contributions and compare it with structural radiomics weighting. Internally, mean structural radiomics weighting was 0.823, whereas mean effective radiomics dominance was 0.148, with a modest case-wise association (\r{ho} = 0.290). The gated image term retained substantially stronger discriminative ranking information than the direct radiomics term. The same structural-to-effective discrepancy was observed in exploratory external evaluation. Branch-targeted permutation, integrated-gradient, and Shapley-style analyses further identified radiomics descriptors influencing the direct radiomics term. Because radiomics also generates the gate, the gated image term remains radiomics-dependent, so additive branch contribution should not be interpreted as total input influence. These findings show that structural gate weighting and decision-level branch contribution represent distinct aspects of gated feature fusion and should be interpreted separately.

AI.tldr: 在3D MedVAE–影像组学融合模型中，门控系数（结构权重）与分类器输出层面的分支贡献并不一致：平均结构影像组学权重为0.823，而有效影像组学主导度仅为0.148，二者仅弱相关（ρ=0.290），提示门控权重不应直接解释为决策层面的分支贡献。
AI.motivation: 门控系数通常被用来描述融合层对中间特征的加权，但该权重未必反映各分支在分类器输出处的实际贡献幅度。作者希望厘清"结构门控权重"与"决策层面分支贡献"这两种不同概念，以避免对门控融合模型的可解释性产生误读。
AI.method: 构建固定的3D MedVAE–影像组学融合模型，用于增强CT上透明细胞型与非透明细胞型肾细胞癌的分类。由于采用线性分类头，二分类logit可精确分解为门控图像项、直接影像组学项与偏置项。作者定义"有效影像组学主导度"为直接影像组学项在非偏置分支贡献绝对值之和中所占比例，并与结构影像组学权重进行比较；进一步采用分支定向置换、积分梯度及Shapley类分析识别影响直接影像组学项的影像组学描述子，并在探索性外部评估中验证。
AI.result: 模型内部平均结构影像组学权重为0.823，而平均有效影像组学主导度仅为0.148，病例层面二者关联较弱（ρ=0.290）。门控图像项保留了明显强于直接影像组学项的判别性排序信息。结构-有效差异在探索性外部评估中同样出现。分支定向置换、积分梯度与Shapley类分析进一步识别出影响直接影像组学项的影像组学描述子。
AI.conclusion: 结构门控权重与决策层面分支贡献是门控特征融合的两个不同侧面，应分别解释。此外，由于影像组学同时生成门控信号，门控图像项仍依赖影像组学，因此加性分支贡献不能被解读为总输入影响。

title: READ: Reading the Selective Scan for Faithful Video Attribution
summary: Selective state-space models are an efficient approach to long-sequence video modeling. However, their recurrent computation makes it difficult to determine which video tokens drive a prediction. Existing attribution methods often require additional backward passes or repeated model evaluations, making them substantially more expensive than the forward inference they aim to explain. In this work, we introduce READ, a parameter-free attribution method for selective state-space models that unrolls the recurrence at the position read by the classifier. READ traces the contribution accumulated in the recurrent state back to the video tokens that contribute to the final prediction. By anchoring attribution at the classifier's readout, it produces a single spatiotemporal relevance map from which frame- and region-level relevance can be obtained directly. Despite requiring only one forward pass, READ achieves competitive faithfulness and localisation compared with substantially more expensive attribution methods. Experimental results show that READ avoids the systematic relevance biases of existing methods while recovering meaningful temporal and class-specific structure across datasets and backbones. More broadly, our results show that the recurrence underlying selective state-space models is not only an efficient mechanism for inference, but also a direct source of interpretable evidence for their predictions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 READ，一种针对选择性状态空间模型（SSM）的免参数归因方法。它在分类器读取位置展开递归，将循环状态中累积的贡献追溯回视频 token，仅需一次前向传播即可生成时空相关性图，在忠实性和定位上达到与高成本方法相当的效果。
AI.motivation: 选择性状态空间模型适合长序列视频建模，但其递归计算难以判断哪些视频 token 驱动了预测。现有归因方法需要额外反向传播或多次模型评估，代价远高于其所要解释的前向推理。
AI.method: READ 在分类器读取的递归位置展开递归，把递归状态中累积的贡献追溯回参与最终预测的视频 token。通过在分类器读出端锚定归因，直接产生单一时空相关性图，可从中直接获得帧级与区域级相关性，全程只需一次前向传播且无需参数。
AI.result: 尽管仅需一次前向传播，READ 在忠实性与定位方面与代价高得多的归因方法相比具有竞争力。实验表明 READ 避免了现有方法系统性的相关性偏差，并在不同数据集和骨干网络上恢复出有意义的时序结构和类别特定结构。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明选择性状态空间模型的递归不仅是高效推理机制，也是其预测可解释证据的直接来源。

title: Detection of extremely rare dead cells in fluorescence microscopy images
summary: Dead cell detection in fluorescence microscopy is essential for phenotypic screening and drug efficacy assessment. However, automated identification remains challenging due to signal variability, optical artifacts, and colocalization ambiguities across multiple channels. Markers that define nuclear boundaries do not neatly coincide spatially or temporally with apoptotic markers. Furthermore, marker accumulation kinetics vary across individual cells and apoptosis stages, making universal thresholds unreliable. We present a systematic comparison of several computational approaches for detecting apoptotic cells in nucleus-stained specimens: (1) heuristic methods using intensity thresholds, distributions, correlations, and domain guidance; (2) classification using numerical features (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, XGBoost and LightGBM) and image features (ResNet-18 and EfficientNet-B0); and (3) anomaly detection, also using numerical features (Isolation Forest, one-class SVM and PCA reconstruction) and image features (convolutional autoencoders and Deep SVDD). Using a dataset of 258 images containing 65,527 cells/nuclei across multiple scenes with 243 manually annotated ground truth dead cells, we evaluate each method on metrics such as PR-AUC, Precision, Recall, F1-score, and macro-F1. Our results indicate that classification using image features (deep learning) and numerical features (traditional) achieved the best performance, with ResNet-18 and XGBoost significantly outperforming manually designed heuristics and anomaly detection methods. Our findings demonstrate that such biomedical problems remain highly challenging to solve even with the state-of-the-art computational and learning techniques. We aim to provide an effective decision-support tool to researchers while tackling such problems either fully-automatically or in a human-in-the-loop setting as an aide to domain scientists.

AI.tldr: 本文系统比较了多种计算方法（启发式阈值、分类、异常检测）在荧光显微图像中检测凋亡/死细胞的性能，发现基于图像特征的深度学习和数值特征的分类方法表现最佳。
AI.motivation: 荧光显微图像中死细胞的自动检测对表型筛选和药效评估至关重要，但由于信号变异、光学伪影、多通道共定位歧义、核边界标记与凋亡标记在时空上不重合，以及标记积累动力学在细胞和凋亡阶段间存在差异，导致通用阈值不可靠，自动化识别仍是难题。
AI.method: 在258张图像、65,527个细胞/核（含243个人工标注的死细胞）的数据集上系统比较三类方法：(1)启发式方法（强度阈值、分布、相关性、领域指导）；(2)分类方法，包括数值特征（Logistic Regression、Random Forest、XGBoost、LightGBM）和图像特征（ResNet-18、EfficientNet-B0）；(3)异常检测，包括数值特征（Isolation Forest、单类SVM、PCA重构）和图像特征（卷积自编码器、Deep SVDD）。以PR-AUC、Precision、Recall、F1、macro-F1等指标评估。
AI.result: 基于图像特征（深度学习）和数值特征（传统）的分类方法取得最佳性能，其中ResNet-18和XGBoost显著优于人工设计的启发式方法和异常检测方法。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，即使采用最先进的计算与学习技术，此类生物医学问题仍极具挑战性。目标是提供有效的决策支持工具，帮助研究人员以全自动或人机协同方式解决此类问题，辅助领域科学家。

title: SimVTA: Simulation-Grounded Video-Trajectory Alignment for Driving World Action Models
summary: Driving world action models (WAMs) learn from paired trajectories and future observations. Post-training with reinforcement learning allows the policy to explore alternative trajectories and improve planning using driving rewards. However, driving logs contain future videos only for the recorded trajectories, leaving these alternatives without corresponding visual supervision. Thus, we introduce SimVTA, a simulation-grounded post-training framework that combines trajectory optimization with video supervision. First, we sample candidate trajectories for each observation and use a real-world simulator (e.g., World Engine) to render future videos for high-reward candidates in real-world scenes reconstructed with 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS). This provides trajectory-matched supervision independent of the model's own predictions. Under a limited rendering budget, we prioritize video supervision for higher-error futures among these rendered candidates. Finally, we optimize trajectory planning with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) and use a flow-matching loss on the matched videos to update shared representations. At inference time, the model predicts trajectories directly, without simulator calls. On NAVSIM v1, applying SimVTA to a WAM initialization improves PDMS from 86.2 to 91.3 (+5.1). It achieves 88.2 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2 and an average HD-Score of 38.8 in closed-loop evaluation on HUGSIM. Ablations show that updating shared representations with video supervision improves planning, while prioritizing higher-error futures among high-reward trajectories further improves performance.

AI.tldr: 提出SimVTA——一种基于仿真的后训练框架，将轨迹优化与视频监督结合，为自动驾驶世界动作模型提供与候选轨迹匹配的未来视频监督，在NAVSIM与HUGSIM上显著提升规划性能。
AI.motivation: 驾驶世界动作模型（WAMs）通过成对的轨迹与未来观测进行学习，强化学习后训练可探索替代轨迹并借助驾驶奖励改进规划。但驾驶日志仅包含已记录轨迹对应的未来视频，替代轨迹缺乏对应的视觉监督，导致轨迹与视觉监督不匹配的监督缺失问题。
AI.method: SimVTA框架：1）对每个观测采样候选轨迹，使用真实世界模拟器（如World Engine）在3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）重建的真实场景中，为高奖励候选轨迹渲染未来视频，提供独立于模型自身预测的轨迹匹配监督；2）在有限渲染预算下，优先对渲染候选中误差较高的未来进行视频监督；3）用组相对策略优化（GRPO）优化轨迹规划，并用匹配视频上的流匹配损失更新共享表征。推理时直接预测轨迹，无需调用模拟器。
AI.result: 在NAVSIM v1上将SimVTA应用于WAM初始化，PDMS从86.2提升至91.3（+5.1）；在NAVSIM v2上达到88.2 EPDMS；在HUGSIM闭环评估中平均HD-Score为38.8。消融实验表明：用视频监督更新共享表征可改进规划，而对高奖励轨迹中较高误差未来进行优先监督可进一步提升性能。
AI.conclusion: SimVTA通过仿真渲染为候选轨迹生成轨迹匹配的视频监督，并结合GRPO轨迹优化与流匹配表征更新，有效解决了替代轨迹缺乏视觉监督的问题，在多个基准上显著提升驾驶世界动作模型的规划性能，且推理阶段无需模拟器。

title: UkrMeme: Multimodal Explainable Persuasion Detection in Ukrainian Memes
summary: Memes play a central role in modern online communication, especially in contexts of political conflict where visual and textual cues combine to convey persuasive messages. We study persuasive technique detection in Ukrainian memes using vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce UkrMeme, a dataset of 200 organically produced Ukrainian wartime memes annotated for persuasion techniques, and PTM-UA, a Ukrainian translation of a subset of the Propaganda 950 benchmark that preserves original visual content while translating meme text. We evaluate VLMs in a zero-shot prompting setup across image, text, and multimodal inputs using hierarchical F1 metrics. Finally, we compare Layer-wise Relevance Propagation (LRP) and model-generated token attributions and analyze the semantic categories of evidence emphasized by each explanation method.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究乌克兰网络迷因中的说服技术检测，构建UkrMeme数据集与PTM-UA基准，采用视觉语言模型进行零样本评估，并使用LRP与模型生成token归因比较解释效果。
AI.motivation: 迷因在现代在线交流中扮演核心角色，尤其在政治冲突情境下，视觉与文本线索共同传递说服性信息；但针对乌克兰语迷因的说服技术检测仍缺乏数据和系统评估。
AI.method: 构建UkrMeme（200个乌克兰战时迷因，标注说服技术）和PTM-UA（Propaganda 950子集的乌克兰语翻译，保留原始视觉内容、翻译迷因文本）；在零样本提示设置下，分别以图像、文本和多模态输入评估视觉语言模型，采用分层F1指标；比较LRP与模型生成token归因，并分析各解释方法强调的证据语义类别。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体数值结果；评估框架覆盖图像、文本和多模态输入，并采用分层F1；解释分析比较LRP与模型生成token归因在证据语义类别上的侧重。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了乌克兰语迷因说服技术检测的数据资源与零样本VLM评估基准，并通过解释方法比较为多模态说服分析的可解释性提供参考。

title: OccludeBench: Can VLMs Find What's Missing?
summary: How well can vision-language models (VLMs) reason about what is missing from an image? We study this question with OccludeBench, a manually curated benchmark for recovering fully occluded objects from the visual evidence that remains. OccludeBench distinguishes direct cases, where the hidden object must be recovered from a specific physical cue such as a shadow or reflection, from inferential cases, where it can be inferred from broader scene context. Across five VLMs, accuracy averages 42.7% on direct cases versus 62.7% on inferential cases, exhibiting a 20.0-point gap. Humans attain higher accuracies of 63.4% versus 68.5% for direct and inferential images, respectively, with no significant gap. To locate this failure, we introduce OccludeTrace, a four-stage diagnostic that isolates where the visual reasoning process breaks down. The bottleneck emerges when models must recover the relevant object from the projection within the full image: they succeed on only 50% of failed examples, compared with 91% of examples they answer correctly. Extended reasoning, tool use, and few-shot prompting yield inconsistent improvements and do not reliably eliminate the gap. In contrast, an inpaint-then-confront intervention, which prompts models to first generate a candidate hidden object and then evaluate that hypothesis against the visible physical cue, reduces the gap to a statistically non-significant difference for both models with image-generation capabilities. Together, our results establish a tractable, controlled diagnostic for isolating how VLMs reason about visual content that is missing from an image.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OccludeBench基准与OccludeTrace诊断方法，研究VLM对图像中被完全遮挡物体的恢复推理能力，发现模型在直接线索（阴影/反射）情境下表现显著弱于推断情境，瓶颈在于从整图中定位并恢复投影线索，而"先补全再验证"的干预可消除该差距。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型（VLM）在图像理解上进展迅速，但其对"图像中缺失内容"的推理能力尚不清楚。作者希望系统性地考察VLM能否依据残留的视觉证据恢复被完全遮挡的物体，并定位其失败环节。
AI.method: 构建人工精标的OccludeBench基准，区分"直接案例"（依赖阴影、反射等具体物理线索）与"推断案例"（依赖更广泛的场景上下文）。在五个VLM上评测，并引入四阶段诊断工具OccludeTrace定位推理断点。同时测试扩展推理、工具调用、少样本提示等干预，以及"先修复(inpaint)再对抗验证(confront)"的干预策略。
AI.result: VLM在直接案例上平均准确率42.7%，推断案例62.7%，相差20.0个百分点；人类为63.4%与68.5%，无显著差距。诊断显示瓶颈出现在模型需从整图投影中恢复相关物体时，失败样本中仅50%成功，而正确样本中达91%。扩展推理、工具使用、少样本提示提升不一致。inpaint-then-confront干预将差距降至统计不显著。
AI.conclusion: OccludeBench与OccludeTrace提供了一个可控、可复现的诊断框架，能够隔离并刻画VLM对图像缺失内容的推理机制；通过先生成候选再对照可见物理线索验证的干预，可有效缓解此类失败。

title: Not Just an Evaluation: A Case Study of Discourse Particle Sensitivity in Language Models
summary: Discourse particles subtly shape the flow of discourse by reflecting conversational context and interlocutor attitudes, often leaving the truth-conditional meaning untouched. They are also often polyfunctional, with distinct senses which partially overlap with other particles; for example, the exclusive use of English "just" and "only" ("John only/just drinks water"). Despite the frequency of these words in natural language, they have gone largely unstudied due to the subtle nature of their effects. We investigate LLM sensitivity to "just" and "only" in natural conversations using behavioral and mechanistic analyses. First, we find that LLMs and humans similarly prefer the presence of these particles in context, and both are more sensitive to "just" compared to "only". Second, when sampling from LLMs with and without these particles, we find LLMs consistently rate generations as more likely, given their source context, demonstrating their particle sensitivity. In both experiments, instruction tuning increases sensitivity. Finally, we localize particle-sensitive units within LLMs and find the overlap between "just" and "only" is asymmetric: "only" units transfer selectively to exclusive "just", while all "just" units transfer to "only" equally well regardless of sense, suggesting LLM lexical-level particle representations are partially organized by sense. We release our code, sense-labeled dialogue stimuli, and human preference annotations at https://github.com/JiahuiKChen/Not_Just_an_Evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过行为实验与机制分析，考察大语言模型对英语话语小品词"just"和"only"的敏感性。结果显示LLM与人类在语境偏好上相似，且对"just"更敏感；指令微调提升敏感性；模型内部存在按语义（sense）部分组织的、非对称重叠的小品词表征。
AI.motivation: 话语小品词（如"just"和"only"）能微妙地反映会话语境与说话者态度，且常具多功能性、语义部分重叠，但其细微效应导致研究匮乏；作者希望探究LLM是否能捕捉这类细微的语言现象。
AI.method: 采用行为分析与机制分析相结合的方法：一是比较LLM与人类对这些小品词在语境中的偏好；二是对含/不含小品词的生成进行采样并评估其似然评分；三是定位LLM内部对小品词敏感的单元，检验"just"与"only"表征的重叠与迁移模式。同时发布代码、义项标注对话刺激材料及人类偏好标注。
AI.result: LLM与人类一样偏好这些小品词的出现，且对"just"比"only"更敏感；模型对含小品词的生成给出更高似然评分，显示其敏感性；指令微调在两项实验中均提升敏感性；机制分析显示"just"与"only"的单元重叠呈非对称性——"only"单元可选择性迁移到排他性"just"，而所有"just"单元无论义项均能同等迁移到"only"。
AI.conclusion: LLM在小品词层面具有可被定位的、部分按义项组织的词汇表征，能够一定程度捕捉话语小品词的细微功能，且这种敏感性受指令微调影响；相关资源已公开。

title: REFLECT: Role-Aware Detection of Sentiment, Emotion, Politeness, and Formality
summary: Detecting communicative meaning in dialogue requires modeling not only lexical content but also the participant-role structures through which sentiment, emotion, politeness, and formality (SEPF) are expressed. Existing approaches rely on contextual language representations while leaving semantic roles implicit. We introduce a role-aware transformer architecture that maps the four SEPF dimensions to theory-grounded Semantic Role Labeling (SRL) configurations, incorporating these configurations directly into the transformer's self-attention mechanism. Role-aware attention models non-directional internal states (sentiment and emotion), while directional role-aware attention captures initiator-to-recipient relations for external cues (politeness and formality). The resulting role-aware representations are fused with contextual embeddings through a learned gate that adaptively weights how much role information each input contributes, rather than appending semantic roles as an auxiliary feature vector. Across four benchmark datasets, the framework yields statistically reliable gains over strong BERT-based baselines for emotion, politeness, and formality, with gains concentrated in theoretically predicted cases such as low-frequency, complex emotions and highly polite expressions; sentiment improvements are marginal and non-significant, suggesting that sentiment is conveyed more through lexical choice than participant-role structure. Additional evaluation on real-world data demonstrates that the framework improves both predictive performance and model traceability. These results demonstrate that linguistically grounded modifications to transformer self-attention improve the detection of communicative meaning, generalize beyond benchmark datasets to real-world mental-health data, and yield traceable, role-grounded explanations that extend beyond predictive performance to interpretability.

AI.tldr: 提出角色感知Transformer，将SEPF映射到SRL配置并嵌入自注意力以提升对话交际意义识别。
AI.motivation: 对话中交际意义的检测不仅依赖词汇内容，还依赖参与者角色结构；现有方法依赖上下文语言表示，却将语义角色隐式处理。
AI.method: 构建角色感知Transformer，将情感、情绪、礼貌、正式性四个SEPF维度映射到理论驱动的语义角色标注配置，并直接融入自注意力：用非方向性角色感知注意力建模情感和情绪等内部状态，用方向性角色感知注意力捕捉礼貌和正式性的发起者—接收者关系；再通过可学习门控将角色表示与上下文嵌入自适应融合。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上，框架在情绪、礼貌和正式性上相较强BERT基线取得统计显著提升，且增益集中在低频率复杂情绪和高礼貌表达等理论预期情形；情感提升边际且不显著。真实世界数据上同时提升预测性能与模型可追溯性。
AI.conclusion: 对Transformer自注意力进行语言学驱动的改造能提升交际意义检测，可泛化到真实世界心理健康数据，并提供可追溯、基于角色的解释。

title: Error Rate is Not Enough: Costs of Augmentation in Low-Resource ASR
summary: Data augmentation is standard practice for low-resource automatic speech recognition (ASR), but its benefits are almost always reported as aggregate error rates, leaving open why and when a method helps. On four low-resource languages and English at five data sizes, we cross two augmentations that modify existing audio (speed perturbation and SpecAugment) with two that modify text transcriptions and synthesize audio from it. We analyze errors at the phoneme level and find that they help for complementary reasons. SpecAugment has the most reliable aggregate improvements, but increases tone and palatalization errors, whereas text-based methods introduce consonant insertions; in combination, each reduces the errors the other introduces. This complementarity is predictable. Tone and palatalization are each signaled by a single acoustic property and occur least frequently in training (lowest training exposure), and text-based methods that flatten word frequency raise their frequency by 37--38%, reversing those errors while further improving aggregate error. The improvement from combining the methods exceeds the sum of their individual improvements; the superadditivity vanishes by 100 hours, limiting the complementarity to the low-resource regime. Where specific error types matter, we recommend selecting augmentation by training exposure and acoustic properties, both measurable before any training.

AI.tldr: 该论文对低资源ASR中音频扰动类（速度扰动、SpecAugment）与文本合成类数据增强进行交叉对比，在音素级错误分析中发现两类方法互补，且互补性可由训练接触量与声学属性预测。
AI.motivation: 低资源ASR的数据增强效果通常只以聚合错误率报告，无法解释方法为何以及在何种条件下有效，因此需要从音素级错误类型层面揭示其作用机制。
AI.method: 在四种低资源语言和英语、五种数据规模下，将两种修改现有音频的增强（速度扰动、SpecAugment）与两种修改文本转写并据此合成音频的增强进行交叉组合，并在音素层面分析错误类型。
AI.result: SpecAugment聚合改进最稳定，但增加声调与腭化错误；文本类方法引入辅音插入；组合后互相抵消对方引入的错误。声调与腭化各由单一声学属性表征且训练中出现频率最低，扁平化词频的文本方法将其频率提高37–38%，从而逆转这些错误并进一步改善聚合错误。组合增益超过各自增益之和，呈超加性，但该效应在100小时后消失。
AI.conclusion: 增强方法的互补性可预测：由训练接触量和声学属性决定，二者在训练前即可测量；因此当特定错误类型重要时，应据此选择增强方法，且互补性仅限低资源区间。

title: Tracing and Taming Hallucinated Terms via Subsequence-Association Filtering and Breadth-Aware Selection for LLM Query Expansion
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now a standard source of query expansion terms but they hallucinate. They inject non existent entities and off-topic terms that add ranking noise and can hurt strong retrievers. Existing remedies such as corpus grounding, mutual verification and preference alignment treat hallucinated terms as an undifferentiated nuisance to be filtered by agreement heuristics, without a mechanistic account of why a given term appears or a principled criterion for how many terms to keep. We propose Subsequence-Association Filtered, breadth-aware query expansion (SAFE-QE), a training-free, retriever agnostic method that draws on the subsequence-association account of hallucination. We score each candidate expansion term by its corpus conditioned cross-context reproducibility, terms that reappear under randomised query contexts yet lack support in the pseudo-relevant set are flagged as products of dominant hallucinatory associations and down-weighted. Drawing on the characterisation of language generation as a trade-off between consistency (no hallucination) and breadth (coverage), we cast term selection as constrained coverage maximisation over the pseudo-relevant set, keeping a set that is approximately broad but consistent and stable across resampling. We also introduce the Hallucinated Expansion Term Rate, a query side faithfulness metric that counts injected expansion terms no relevant document supports. We evaluate our approach on benchmarked TREC and BEIR collections. Our SAFE-QE is statistically indistinguishable from generative and corpus-steered expansion on nDCG@10 while injecting fewer unsupported terms 4.3 per query against 27.8 for Query2doc and 57.5 for HyDE and on a strong learned sparse retriever, where every expansion method regresses. Faithfulness is therefore available at no measurable cost in ranking quality.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练、与检索器无关的查询扩展方法SAFE-QE，基于子序列联想幻觉理论对扩展词打分，将词选择建模为受约束的覆盖最大化问题，在保持nDCG@10相当的同时大幅减少注入的无效扩展词。
AI.motivation: LLM作为查询扩展词来源时会幻觉，注入不存在的实体和跑题词，给排序引入噪声、损害强检索器。现有补救方法（语料接地、互相验证、偏好对齐）把幻觉词视为无差别噪声，用一致性启发式过滤，既缺乏对某词为何出现的机制性解释，也没有保留多少词的原理性准则。
AI.method: SAFE-QE依据子序列联想幻觉解释，将每个候选扩展词按其在语料条件下的跨上下文可复现性打分：在随机化查询上下文下反复出现却缺乏伪相关集支撑的词，被判定为主导性幻觉联想的产物并降权。借鉴语言生成在一致性（无幻觉）与广度（覆盖）间权衡的特性，把词选择形式化为伪相关集上的受约束覆盖最大化，保留在重采样下近似广而一致、稳定的词集合。另提出查询侧忠实度指标HETR（幻觉扩展词率），统计无相关文档支撑的注入扩展词数量。
AI.result: 在TREC和BEIR基准上评测。SAFE-QE在nDCG@10上与生成式及语料引导式扩展在统计上不可区分，但每查询注入的无效词更少：4.3个，对比Query2doc的27.8个和HyDE的57.5个；在强学习稀疏检索器（所有扩展方法均退化）上同样成立。
AI.conclusion: 忠实度可在排序质量无可测损失的前提下获得。

title: QTestBench: A Test Framework for Evaluating LLM-Generated Quantum Code
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE 2nd International Conference on Quantum Artificial Intelligence (QAI), 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong results in classical code generation and are increasingly used to write the unit tests that safeguard that code. Whether they can do the same for quantum software is less clear, because quantum programs are probabilistic, depend on numerical tolerances, and are judged by domain-specific checkers, so a well-formed test can still disagree with the benchmark's verdict. Existing quantum benchmarks measure whether a model produces a correct solution, but not whether its tests can distinguish correct implementations from faulty ones. We introduce QTestBench, a framework that evaluates LLM-generated quantum test suites against independent benchmark checkers, never treating the tests themselves as ground truth. For each task, QTestBench prompts models to produce syntactic, semantic, and behavioral tests, injects candidate solutions at runtime, and compares each test verdict with the checker's label under three validation cohorts, each answering a distinct diagnostic question. We benchmark five LLMs on eight PennyLane QHack challenges and ten Qiskit HumanEval tasks. Generated suites almost always execute, but discrimination lags behind: the best generator reaches a test quality of 0.71 on QHack and 0.34 on Qiskit HumanEval, so executability alone overstates test quality. Oracle-verified synthetic mutants stabilize bug-detection estimates when natural faulty solutions are scarce, as on three of ten Qiskit tasks that yield none. QTestBench offers a reproducible, cross-framework benchmark for the trustworthiness of LLM-generated quantum tests.

AI.tldr: 提出QTestBench框架，评估LLM生成的量子程序测试套件能否区分正确与错误实现，覆盖8个PennyLane QHack和10个Qiskit HumanEval任务。
AI.motivation: LLM在经典代码生成与单元测试上表现良好，但量子程序具有概率性、依赖数值容差、并由领域专用检查器判定，导致形式正确的测试仍可能与基准判定不一致。现有量子基准只衡量模型能否给出正确解，未衡量其测试能否区分正确实现与错误实现，因此缺乏对LLM生成量子测试可信度的评估手段。
AI.method: QTestBench以独立基准检查器为判定依据，不将测试本身视为真值。对每个任务，提示模型生成语法、语义和行为三类测试，并在运行时注入候选解，在三个验证队列下将每个测试判定与检查器标签比较，每个队列回答一个独立诊断问题。同时使用经oracle验证的合成变异体，在自然错误解稀缺时稳定缺陷检测估计。在5个LLM、8个PennyLane QHack挑战与10个Qiskit HumanEval任务上进行基准测试。
AI.result: 生成的测试套件几乎总能执行，但区分能力明显滞后：最佳生成器在QHack上的测试质量为0.71，在Qiskit HumanEval上仅0.34，说明可执行性会高估测试质量。在10个Qiskit任务中有3个无法获得自然错误解，此时oracle验证的合成变异体可稳定缺陷检测估计。
AI.conclusion: QTestBench提供了可复现、跨框架的基准，用于评估LLM生成量子测试的可信度，揭示了可执行性与实际判别能力之间的显著差距。

title: Spanning Diffusion and Flow-based Posterior Sampling via Exact Gaussian Conditioning
summary: Flow-matching and diffusion models are increasingly used as priors for linear inverse problems, however, most methods are bespoke to one class of trajectory prior. Plug-and-play methods have been proposed, however these implicitly decorrelate the guided trajectory, resulting in broad priors that can struggle when data is sparse. This work proposes $β$-Flow: a general plug-and-play method indexed by a correlation parameter $β$ that generalises over flow, diffusion, and decorrelated priors, and a confidence parameter $κ$ that controls how strongly the path distribution is enforced. Each step requires only one forward evaluation of a denoising network, followed by a Gaussian conditioning step. This step is an exact Kalman update that is not dependent on network gradients. We show that many existing guided samplers can be interpreted as instances or approximations of our method, each implicitly using a different trajectory prior and operator in place of the Kalman gain. From this viewpoint, we provide a qualitative comparison of methods in terms of their implicit biases and assumptions. We demonstrate consistently state-of-the-art level performance across 7 inverse problems over 4 datasets in terms of PSNR and SSIM. Moreover, we demonstrate the utility of this prior control, by showing that confident high correlations (strict priors) work best when observations are less informative, while low correlation is preferred when observations are more informative, reflecting the complementary roles of the prior and likelihood in Bayesian inference.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 β-Flow，一个通用的 plug-and-play 线性逆问题求解框架，通过相关参数 β 与置信参数 κ 统一了 flow、diffusion 及去相关先验，每步仅为一次去噪网络前向加一次高斯（Kalman）条件更新，无需网络梯度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 flow-matching 与 diffusion 先验的线性逆问题方法多为针对某一类轨迹先验的定制方法；plug-and-play 方法虽通用，却隐式地去相关化引导轨迹，导致先验过宽，在观测稀疏时表现不佳。作者希望提出一个可统一建模不同先验相关结构、并可调节先验约束强度的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出 β-Flow：以相关参数 β 索引的通用 plug-and-play 方法，β 可在 flow、diffusion 与去相关先验间泛化；另设置信参数 κ 控制路径分布的约束强度。每步仅需一次去噪网络前向评估，随后进行一次高斯条件化，该步骤为精确的 Kalman 更新，不依赖网络梯度。作者进一步证明众多现有引导采样器可视为该方法的特例或近似，各自隐含使用不同的轨迹先验与替代 Kalman 增益的算子，并据此对其隐式偏差与假设进行定性比较。
AI.result: 在 4 个数据集、7 个逆问题任务上，该方法在 PSNR 与 SSIM 上取得一致的最优（state-of-the-art）水平表现。同时验证了先验控制的有效性：当观测信息量较低时，高相关性的严格先验（confident high correlations）效果最佳；当观测信息量较高时，低相关性更优，体现了贝叶斯推断中先验与似然的互补作用。
AI.conclusion: β-Flow 提供了一个统一、通用且高效的 plug-and-play 框架，将 flow、diffusion 与去相关先验纳入同一参数化体系，并揭示了现有引导采样方法的内在联系。其实验结果显示其在多个逆问题上达到 SOTA，并可通过 β、κ 显式权衡先验与似然的贡献，为线性逆问题的先验选择提供了理论视角与实用工具。

title: Dream to Remember: Continual Steering of Generalist Robot Policies with World Models
summary: Generalist robot policies are trained with imitation learning and are bounded by the quality and coverage of their demonstrations. Reinforcement learning can improve and extend them, either by fine-tuning the policy weights or by training a small module to steer the input noise of a frozen generative policy. When tasks arrive sequentially, both approaches suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Fine-tuning on a task degrades prior tasks, and steering only shifts forgetting to the shared steering module. We propose Dream to Remember (D2R), which continually steers a frozen generalist policy toward new tasks, while retaining its earlier skills. As the steering module learns a new task, a frozen pretrained world model rehearses prior tasks through imagined rollouts, anchoring the module to its earlier behavior without a replay buffer or new data. When the world model is faithful enough, D2R learns the new task entirely in imagination. Otherwise, it learns the task in the environment while using the world model only to rehearse prior tasks. On CALVIN, D2R improves eight tasks in sequence entirely in imagination, raising average success from 63.7% to 74.8%, while LoRA fine-tuning on the same sequence drops it to 11.7%. With a frozen off-the-shelf generalist policy and world model, $π_0$ and A2World, D2R learns unseen LIBERO-90 tasks in the environment while keeping $π_0$'s performance on the LIBERO suites it was fine-tuned on, even though the world model is not accurate enough for policy optimization. Finally, on a real Franka robot, D2R improves three tasks in sequence entirely in imagination while retaining the earlier improvements.

AI.tldr: 提出 D2R，通过冻结世界模型的想象回放持续引导冻结的通用策略学习新任务，避免灾难性遗忘，在 CALVIN、LIBERO-90 与真机上均取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 通用机器人策略依赖模仿学习，受限于示教数据的质量与覆盖度；用强化学习改进时，无论是微调策略权重还是训练噪声引导模块，在任务顺序到来时都会遭遇灾难性遗忘：微调会破坏旧任务，引导则把遗忘转移到共享的引导模块上。
AI.method: D2R 在冻结的通用策略上持续训练一个引导模块，并用冻结的预训练世界模型对旧任务进行想象 rollout 作为排练，无需回放缓冲区或新数据。若世界模型足够忠实，则新任务完全在想象中学习；否则在真实环境中学习新任务，世界模型仅用于排练旧任务。
AI.result: CALVIN 上顺序学习八个任务（全在想象中），平均成功率由 63.7% 提升至 74.8%，而同序列 LoRA 微调降至 11.7%；在冻结的 π0 与 A2World 上，D2R 于真实环境中学习未见过的 LIBERO-90 任务，并保持 π0 在原有 LIBERO 套件上的性能，即便世界模型精度不足以做策略优化；在真实 Franka 机器人上，D2R 完全在想象中顺序提升三个任务并保留先前改进。
AI.conclusion: 借助冻结世界模型的想象排练来持续引导冻结通用策略，可在顺序任务设定下有效缓解灾难性遗忘并扩展新技能，且在世界模型精度有限或真实机器人场景下同样可行。

title: Can Language Models Learn When to Abstain? Policy Learning and Calibrated Answer Selection
summary: A useful language model should know when to answer and when to say "I don't know." Can we improve that decision by training the model itself or by training a separate component to check its answers? We study both approaches on Qwen3-14B for factual questions, using a score that rewards correct answers, penalizes mistakes, and allows abstention. Across three training seeds and two held-out confidence thresholds, a learned answer selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the original model's calibrated confidence filter. On TriviaQA, mean coverage increases from 20.2% to 30.9%, while the pooled error rate among scored answers decreases from 23.0% to 14.5% under exact-match grading. The tested reinforcement-learning changes do not establish consistent gains. On NQ-Open, the selector improves threshold-averaged utility over the filter but still performs worse than always abstaining. A partial human-reviewed audit preserves the TriviaQA finding. Our results support learning to select answers in this setting while showing that reliable abstention across datasets remains unresolved.

AI.tldr: 在Qwen3-14B上对比"训练模型自身"与"训练独立答案选择器"两种方案，结果表明学习式答案选择器在TriviaQA上优于原始模型的校准置信度过滤，但可靠的跨数据集弃答问题仍未解决。
AI.motivation: 语言模型应知道何时作答、何时说"不知道"。作者希望探究：这一决策能力应通过训练模型本身获得，还是通过训练一个独立组件来核查答案更好。
AI.method: 以Qwen3-14B为基座，针对事实性问题研究两种方案；采用一个奖励正确答案、惩罚错误并允许弃答的评分函数。实验覆盖三个训练种子与两个留出置信度阈值，并辅以部分人工复核审计。
AI.result: 在TriviaQA上，学习式答案选择器提升了阈值平均效用，平均覆盖率由20.2%升至30.9%，计分答案的合并错误率由23.0%降至14.5%（精确匹配）。所测试的强化学习改动未带来一致增益。在NQ-Open上，选择器虽优于过滤基线，但仍不如"始终弃答"。人工复核审计保持了TriviaQA的结论。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持在该设定下"学习选择答案"，但表明跨数据集可靠的弃答能力仍是有待解决的问题。

title: OpenPA: Forced-alignment-free Multi-granular Pronunciation Assessment with Mixed-transcript Adaptation
summary: Recent advances in automatic pronunciation assessment (APA) have driven a shift from scripted to free-form assessment. However, existing methods often rely on multi-stage pipelines with forced alignment and separate feature extractors, limiting their practicality across response settings. In light of this, we propose OpenPA, a novel APA framework that leverages Whisper's cross-attention mechanism to jointly predict word- and utterance-level pronunciation scores without forced alignment. Through mixed-transcript adaptation and adaptive substitution weighting, OpenPA accommodates heterogeneous transcripts across closed- and open-response settings within a single model. Trained solely on speechocean762, OpenPA achieves the strongest overall performance among evaluated systems under in-domain closed and simulated open-response conditions, while maintaining its performance zero-shot on MultiPA. An additional cross-task evaluation on oral-cancer speech suggests its potential applicability beyond non-native speech.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 OpenPA，一个基于 Whisper 交叉注意力机制的自动发音评测（APA）框架，无需强制对齐即可联合预测词级与句级发音分数，通过混合转写适配与自适应替换加权在单一模型中兼容封闭式与开放式作答，性能领先。
AI.motivation: 现有 APA 方法多依赖多阶段流水线（强制对齐与独立特征提取器），在封闭式与开放式作答场景下实用性受限，因此需要一种统一、端到端且适应性强的框架。
AI.method: OpenPA 利用 Whisper 的交叉注意力机制联合预测词级与句级发音分数，省去强制对齐；采用混合转写适配（mixed-transcript adaptation）与自适应替换加权（adaptive substitution weighting）以在单一模型内兼容异构转写的封闭式与开放式作答。
AI.result: 仅使用 speechocean762 训练，OpenPA 在域内封闭式及模拟开放式作答条件下取得所评测系统中最强的整体性能，并在 MultiPA 上保持零样本性能；额外的跨任务口腔癌语音评测显示其超越非母语语音场景的潜在适用性。
AI.conclusion: OpenPA 通过交叉注意力与自适应机制统一了封闭式与开放式 APA，去除了强制对齐与多阶段流水线，具备良好泛化性与跨任务迁移潜力。

title: TrajCFG: Token-Wise Classifier-Free Guidance via Denoising Trajectory Feedback
summary: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) typically applies a shared scale to all latent tokens, although their velocity predictions evolve differently during sampling. We introduce Trajectory-Adaptive Classifier-Free Guidance (TrajCFG), a training-free method for flow-matching models that adapts token-wise guidance using historical changes in guided velocity direction. TrajCFG maps this feedback to bounded scales, assigning stronger guidance to larger directional changes and weaker guidance to more consistent directions. It combines adjacent-step and interval-normalized longer-span feedback, reusing standard CFG predictions without additional model evaluations. Controlled diagnostics and ablations examine the roles of directional feedback, token-wise allocation, and history-span fusion. Experiments on text-to-video, image-to-video, text-to-audio-video, text-to-image, and image-to-3D generation show improvements over base samplers across multiple backbones. For text-to-video generation, TrajCFG improves VBench Total scores by 0.30-0.75 points over the strongest evaluated baseline on each of three backbones. These results support historical directional feedback as a broadly applicable signal for fine-grained guidance allocation. The project page is available at https://jyliu-98.github.io/trajcfg-project-page/.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练方法TrajCFG，利用引导速度方向的历史变化实现逐token自适应无分类器引导，在视频、图像、音频、3D等多任务上提升生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有无分类器引导（CFG）对所有latent token使用统一引导尺度，但采样过程中各token的速度预测演化并不相同，统一尺度无法实现细粒度引导分配。
AI.method: TrajCFG将引导速度方向的历史变化作为反馈信号，映射为有界尺度：方向变化大的token给更强引导，方向变化一致的token给更弱引导；融合相邻步反馈与区间归一化的长跨度反馈，复用标准CFG预测，不增加额外模型评估。通过受控诊断与消融分析方向反馈、逐token分配与历史跨度融合的作用。
AI.result: 在文生视频、图生视频、文本-音频-视频、文生图与图像到3D生成任务上，于多种backbone上优于基础采样器。文生视频中，TrajCFG在三个backbone上分别将VBench Total分数较最强基线提升0.30–0.75分。
AI.conclusion: 历史方向反馈可作为广泛适用的细粒度引导分配信号，TrajCFG验证了逐token自适应引导的有效性与通用性。

title: SpatialASM: Internalizing Active Mentalization for Spatial Reasoning
summary: When solving complex spatial reasoning tasks, ordinary humans naturally revisit the scenes from task-relevant viewpoints and mentally reconstruct the spatial layouts from those viewpoints. But can Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) proactively think in the same way? We term this ability Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM), an intrinsic component of visual intelligence that remains substantially underdeveloped in current LVLMs. To bridge this gap, we introduce SpatialASM, a scalable framework to internalize ASM into LVLMs through training-time spatial simulation. SpatialASM employs an allocentric novel-view generator to ground hypothetical viewpoints in visual evidence and produces two complementary forms of supervision: i) explicit ASM trajectories that teach LVLMs when and how to adaptively invoke view planning and imagination during spatial reasoning, and ii) automatically-constructed perspective-taking tasks that further strengthens viewpoint-conditioned scene imagination. On seven benchmarks spanning relatively perception-oriented spatial understanding to more challenging tasks requiring multi-image, cross-view and viewpoint-transformation reasoning, SpatialASM yields performance gain on LVLMs of four LVLM backbones in spatial reasoning while retaining their original general vision capabilities. The experimental results demonstrate that our approach improves average accuracy across the seven spatial benchmarks. And the synthesis of ASM trajectories provides a scalable pathway to alleviate the scarcity of spatial Chain-of-Thought (CoT) supervision for eliciting active viewpoint exploration and mental scene simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Active Spatial Mentalization (ASM)能力，并设计SpatialASM框架，通过训练时空间模拟将主动视角规划与场景想象内化到LVLM中，在七个空间推理基准上提升多种骨干模型的性能。
AI.motivation: 人类在解决复杂空间推理任务时会主动从任务相关视角重访场景并在脑中重建空间布局，而当前LVLM缺乏这种主动心理化能力；同时空间链式思维(CoT)监督数据稀缺，制约了模型主动视角探索与心理场景模拟能力的发展。
AI.method: SpatialASM采用训练时空间模拟框架：使用非自我中心(allocentric)新视角生成器将假设视角锚定到视觉证据上，并产生两类互补监督——i）显式ASM轨迹，教LVLM何时及如何自适应调用视角规划与想象；ii）自动构建的视角采择任务，强化视角条件下的场景想象。
AI.result: 在涵盖感知导向空间理解到多图、跨视角、视角变换推理的七个基准上，SpatialASM在四种LVLM骨干上均取得空间推理性能提升，同时保留原有通用视觉能力。
AI.conclusion: SpatialASM能提升七个空间基准的平均准确率，且ASM轨迹的合成提供了一条可扩展路径，缓解空间CoT监督稀缺问题，激发主动视角探索与心理场景模拟。

title: Axiom-0: Hierarchical Self-Refinement for Vision-Language-Action Policies
summary: Reliable manipulation requires policies that generalize across tasks, layouts, and object interactions. Vision-language-action (VLA) models combine pretrained multimodal understanding with learned control, but their performance remains limited on unfamiliar task compositions. We present Axiom-0, a VLA policy that addresses both the quality of its representations and their use in action generation through hierarchical self-refinement. Intra-VLM Representation Refinement (IVRR) strengthens selected intermediate features through consistency supervision with learned feature projections during training. VLM-Action Interface Refinement (VAIR) recursively updates the resulting conditioning before action generation. Joint optimization of the supervised VLM layers, VAIR, and the action generator connects the two components. On RoboCasa365, Axiom-0 achieves 62.32% overall success in our evaluation, exceeding the highest published leaderboard score (Paimon-0, 58.1%) by 4.22 percentage points and the Xiaomi-Robotics-1 reference by 4.92 points. Under the evaluated profiling setup, mean action-chunk generation latency increases by 1.7% over Xiaomi-Robotics-1. These results demonstrate improved task completion with modest inference overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 Axiom-0 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，通过分层自精炼同时改进表征质量与动作生成，在 RoboCasa365 上以 62.32% 成功率超越已公开最优结果，推理延迟仅增加 1.7%。
AI.motivation: 可靠的操作任务要求策略能够跨任务、布局和物体交互泛化。VLA 模型虽结合了预训练多模态理解与学习到的控制能力，但在不熟悉的任务组合上表现仍受限，其瓶颈既在于表征质量，也在于表征在动作生成中的使用方式。
AI.method: Axiom-0 采用分层自精炼框架，包含两个组件：IVRR（Intra-VLM Representation Refinement）在训练中借助学习到的特征投影进行一致性监督，强化选定的中间层特征；VAIR（VLM-Action Interface Refinement）在动作生成前递归更新所得条件表征。同时对监督的 VLM 层、VAIR 与动作生成器进行联合优化，将两部分连接起来。
AI.result: 在 RoboCasa365 上，Axiom-0 取得 62.32% 的总体成功率，比公开排行榜最高分（Paimon-0，58.1%）高 4.22 个百分点，比 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 参考基线高 4.92 个百分点；在评测所用的 profiling 设置下，平均动作块生成延迟相比 Xiaomi-Robotics-1 仅增加 1.7%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，分层自精炼能够在适度的推理开销下提升任务完成率，为 VLA 策略在陌生任务组合上的泛化提供了一条有效路径。

title: Studying Comics at Scale with Artificial Intelligence: The PAGE Framework and Three Studies of American Comics and Japanese Manga
summary: Comics are one of the great visual records of the twentieth century: hundreds of thousands of pages in which a mass readership saw its leaders, its wars and its heroes. Most of this record has never been studied as a whole; comics scholarship proceeds one book at a time. We argue that artificial intelligence, including generative models, can change this to the benefit of the medium itself. We propose PAGE, a framework that makes artificial intelligence an instrument for comics research. It parses every scan into panels, text and a bibliographic record; annotates each page with a vision-language model that follows a written codebook, as a human coder would; grounds samples of these readings in human annotation; and explains change across an archive, with estimates controlled for publisher and genre. We demonstrate the framework on 3,929 American comic books (1938--1956) and 87 volumes of Japanese manga, in three studies, each resting on a different capability. The first pairs text search with visual reading to recover how a mass medium portrayed political power. The second measures the page's visual form across an industry and recovers the hand of individual artists. The third follows who speaks across two comics traditions, checked against human annotation. Beyond research, the same instruments can make archives searchable by what is drawn, open comics to blind and low-vision readers, and help preserve fragile collections and credit uncredited artists. We outline a research agenda in which artificial intelligence strengthens the study, preservation and reach of the medium.

AI.tldr: 提出PAGE框架，用AI（含生成模型）将漫画档案解析为分格、文本与书目记录，并以视觉语言模型按编码手册进行标注、以人工标注校验，从而支持大规模漫画研究。
AI.motivation: 漫画是20世纪重要的视觉记录，但绝大多数内容从未被整体研究，漫画研究长期停留在"一次一本"的个案层面，缺乏跨档案、可比较的系统分析手段。
AI.method: PAGE框架：将每页扫描解析为分格（panels）、文本和书目记录；用遵循书面编码手册的视觉语言模型模拟人工编码者对每页进行标注；将部分模型判读结果与人工标注对齐校验；在控制出版商与体裁变量后，解释整个档案中的历时变化。在3,929本美国漫画（1938–1956）与87卷日本漫画上开展三项研究。
AI.result: 三项研究分别验证不同能力：一是结合文本检索与视觉阅读，还原大众媒介对政治权力的呈现方式；二是跨产业测量页面视觉形式，识别出个别艺术家的"手笔"；三是追踪两种漫画传统中的言说主体，并与人工标注进行对照检验。
AI.conclusion: 除研究用途外，同类工具可实现按"画面内容"检索档案、服务盲人与低视力读者、助力脆弱藏品的保存与佚名艺术家的署名认定，并提出以AI强化漫画研究、保存与传播的研究议程。

title: Event-based Action Recognition by Pre-Training on Multi-Frame Representations
summary: Action recognition is a crucial task in domains like robotics, patient monitoring, or surveillance. Recently, event-based action recognition has attracted much attention due to the event camera's ability to capture fast motions and its improved privacy over conventional vision cameras. While frame-based event representations work well for short event sequences, their discriminative ability declines sharply with longer and more complex event sequences. In this work, we introduce a multi-frame representation that greatly improves recognition performance over its single-frame counterpart. We adopt a masked auto-encoding framework to pre-train a Vision Transformer using a sparsity-aware masking algorithm and token selection mechanism to improve downstream performance and control computational complexity. We also introduce multiple mask tokens for the decoder with a position-aware attention mechanism, leading to further improved performance. Our proposed method shows impressive performance for challenging long-duration and complex event sequences, yielding state-of-the-art performance on THU-EACT-50 CHL and DailyDVS-200.

AI.tldr: 提出多帧事件表示与掩码自编码Vision Transformer预训练框架，在长时复杂事件序列动作识别上达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 事件相机可捕捉快速运动且隐私性优于传统相机，故事件动作识别备受关注。但基于帧的事件表示在短序列上表现良好，随事件序列变长、变复杂，其判别能力急剧下降。
AI.method: 提出性能优于单帧的多帧表示；采用掩码自编码框架预训练Vision Transformer，引入稀疏度感知掩码算法与token选择机制以提升下游性能并控制计算量；解码器引入多重掩码token及位置感知注意力机制。
AI.result: 在长时且复杂的事件序列上表现优异，于THU-EACT-50 CHL和DailyDVS-200数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.conclusion: 多帧表示结合掩码自编码预训练、稀疏度感知掩码、token选择及多重掩码token的位置感知注意力，可有效应对长时复杂事件序列的动作识别。

title: Revisiting the Task of Building Damage Assessment by Satellite Imaging
summary: Natural disasters such as earthquakes, tropical storms, and floods cause extensive damage to buildings, and rapid, reliable damage maps are essential to guide emergency response. Automating this task, referred to as building damage assessment (BDA), from satellite imagery, has become an active research topic at the intersection of remote sensing, computer vision, and machine learning, particularly since supervised deep learning methods were shown to outperform earlier handcrafted approaches. Yet, despite a decade of intense activity and the release of several large-scale datasets, the field lacks a shared foundation. This chapter revisits the task of BDA from first principles, organized around three pillars: data, evaluation, and methods. We first clarify the candidate task for- mulations and argue for a sensor-agnostic, instance-based definition that tolerates missing pre-event imagery. We then review existing datasets along the axes of sensing modality, temporal configuration, and geographic coverage. On the evaluation side, we show that prevailing practices, largely based on a single aggregate score, are theoretically fragile, and we lay the foundations of a more informative, ranking-based, multi-score protocol. We further review methods ranging from task-specific deep networks to recent Earth observation foundation models, noticing that generalization to unseen events and regions remains an open difficulty. Finally, we discuss how these elements can inform the organization of a BDA challenge, including cross-validation, challenge, and private data-sharing setups designed to build trust between developers and users.

AI.tldr: 本文从第一性原理出发，围绕数据、评估与方法三大支柱系统梳理建筑物损毁评估（BDA）任务，提出传感器无关、基于实例且容忍缺失灾前影像的任务定义，指出现有聚合评分评估方式的脆弱性并构建更具信息量的排序式多指标评估协议，综述从专用深度网络到地球观测基础模型的方法，并讨论BDA竞赛的组织方式。
AI.motivation: 地震、热带风暴、洪水等自然灾害对建筑造成巨大破坏，快速可靠的损毁地图对应急响应至关重要。尽管卫星影像自动BDA研究已活跃十年并发布多个大规模数据集，但该领域仍缺乏共享基础，任务定义、数据集与评估实践不统一，且对未见过事件和区域的泛化仍是难题。
AI.method: 采用综述与理论分析相结合的方式，从第一性原理重审BDA任务，按数据、评估、方法三支柱组织：厘清候选任务表述，论证传感器无关的基于实例定义；沿传感模态、时间配置、地理覆盖等维度梳理现有数据集；分析评估实践的理论缺陷并构建排序式多评分协议；综述从任务专用深度网络到地球观测基础模型的方法；并讨论BDA竞赛的组织方案。
AI.result: 提出了一种传感器无关、基于实例、可容忍缺失灾前影像的BDA任务定义；揭示了以单一聚合分数为主的现有评估实践在理论上脆弱；初步建立了更具信息量的基于排序的多评分评估协议框架；并指出方法层面对未见过事件和区域的泛化仍为开放难题。
AI.conclusion: BDA领域需要建立共享基础：统一任务定义、更严谨的多指标评估协议与可信的基准。这些要素可指导BDA挑战赛的组织，包括交叉验证、挑战赛及私有数据共享等设置，从而在开发者与用户之间建立信任。

title: LapMerge: Differentiable Exact-Budget Token Merging in Linear Time
summary: Modern vision and language models process ever longer token sequences, and reducing them is the main lever on downstream cost. Token compression, however, faces a fundamental trade-off: selecting tokens discards information, while existing merging methods preserve it only through pairwise token-to-token matching or $MN$ token-to-output interactions. We introduce LapMerge, a differentiable merging operator that resolves this trade-off for ordered sequences: a learned mass distribution partitions the sequence into exactly $N$ equal-mass segments under a Laplace-kernel density, and prefix/suffix scans aggregate each segment, so both the forward and the backward pass run in $O(M+N)$ time. This combination (an exact output budget, end-to-end differentiability, and linear cost) is precisely what previous reducers trade off against one another. The budget can be changed without changing operator parameters, and the learned mass doubles as a token-level map of where the budget is allocated. Across vision and vision-language tasks, LapMerge matches or improves on strong token reducers while being up to two orders of magnitude faster at large sequence lengths; it is particularly effective when token order reflects spatial or temporal locality, and works both as a drop-in reduction module and as a trainable architectural component.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 LapMerge，一种面向有序序列的可微合并算子，通过学习到的质量分布将序列分割为恰好 N 个等质量段，实现 O(M+N) 的前向与反向计算，在视觉与视觉-语言任务中匹配或超越强 token 压缩方法，且在大序列长度下快至两个数量级。
AI.motivation: 视觉与语言模型处理的 token 序列越来越长，减少 token 数是降低下游成本的主要手段。但 token 压缩存在根本性权衡：选择型方法会丢弃信息，而现有合并方法仅通过成对 token 匹配或 M×N 的 token-to-output 交互来保留信息，难以兼顾信息保留与计算效率。
AI.method: LapMerge 是一个可微合并算子：利用学习到的质量分布，在拉普拉斯核密度下将有序序列划分为恰好 N 个等质量段；再通过前缀/后缀扫描聚合每个段，使前向与反向传播均达到 O(M+N) 复杂度。该设计同时实现精确输出预算、端到端可微性与线性开销，且改变预算无需改变算子参数，学习到的质量还可作为 token 级的预算分配图。
AI.result: 在视觉与视觉-语言任务上，LapMerge 匹配或优于强 token 压缩器，并在大序列长度下快至两个数量级；当 token 顺序反映空间或时间局部性时效果尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: LapMerge 兼顾了此前压缩方法相互权衡的三项特性——精确输出预算、端到端可微性与线性成本，既可作即插即用的压缩模块，也可作可训练架构组件。

title: Make It Flow: Animating Water in 3D Gaussian Splatting Scenes
summary: Explicit 3D scene representations such as 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have recently enabled high-quality, real-time novel view synthesis. However, these methods assume static scenes, limiting realism in the presence of dynamic phenomena ubiquitous in real-world environments. While coherent motion (e.g., humans or vehicles) can be captured and reconstructed, high-frequency effects such as flowing water remain intractable under casual capture conditions, where dense multi-view, high-speed acquisition is not feasible. We present a method to animate water in static 3DGS scenes, enabling visually plausible motion without requiring dynamic capture or physical simulation. Our approach estimates 2D optical flow from reference images or model renderings and lifts it into a consistent 3D Eulerian motion field. We propose a cinemagraph-inspired algorithm that applies this motion field to deform Gaussian primitives, producing temporally seamless looping animations. The resulting representation retains real-time rendering performance, significantly enhances perceptual realism, and preserves free-viewpoint navigation within the scene. We evaluate our method on a newly captured dataset of in-the-wild waterfall scenes and demonstrate clear improvements over prior work in dynamic Gaussian splatting and 3D cinemagraph generation in visual quality and computational efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在静态3DGS场景中动画化水流的方法，通过从参考图像或渲染图估计2D光流并提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场，结合灵感来自cinemagraph的算法对高斯原语进行形变，实现无需动态采集或物理仿真的无缝循环动画，保持实时渲染性能。
AI.motivation: 现有显式3D场景表示（如3DGS）假设场景静态，限制了真实性。虽然相干运动（如人或车辆）可被重建，但高频率效应（如流水）在随性采集条件下难以处理，因为无法获得密集多视角高速采集。
AI.method: 1) 从参考图像或模型渲染估计2D光流；2) 将光流提升为一致的3D欧拉运动场；3) 提出cinemagraph启发的算法，将运动场应用于高斯原语形变，生成时间上无缝循环的动画。
AI.result: 在新采集的野外瀑布场景数据集上评估，在视觉质量和计算效率方面均明显优于先前的动态高斯泼溅和3D cinemagraph生成工作。结果表示保留实时渲染性能，显著增强感知真实感，并保持场景内的自由视点导航。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够为静态3DGS场景中的水流添加视觉上合理的运动，无需动态采集或物理仿真，兼顾实时渲染与自由视点导航，在视觉质量和效率上超越现有方法。

title: Tracking the Invisible: Self-Supervised Wheel Track Detection with Thermal-RGB Fusion
summary: Accurate detection of drivable area is essential for autonomous driving and advanced driver assistance systems. While state-of-the-art methods focus on general traversability estimation, they prove inadequate for snow-covered roads where following existing wheel tracks offers crucial advantages: improved traction, predictable vehicle dynamics, and verified path stability. To address this, we propose a low-cost, self-supervised approach detecting safety-critical wheel tracks using synchronized RGB-I (RGB + Long-Wave Infrared) imagery. Our method automatically generates training labels by projecting future wheel trajectories from recorded GNSS data. A neural network is designed to identify wheel tracks with the 4-channel RGB-I images from challenging, white-out road surfaces. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach in visually monotonous and featureless adverse environment, offering a robust and cost-effective alternative for winter autonomy. The newly introduced ThermalTrack dataset is available at: https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/thermaltrack/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种低成本、自监督的方法，利用同步RGB-I（可见光+长波红外）图像检测冰雪覆盖道路上安全关键的车辙，通过投影GNSS记录的未来车轮轨迹自动生成训练标签，并在缺乏视觉特征的恶劣环境中验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有可行驶区域检测方法主要针对一般可通行性估计，在雪覆盖道路上表现不足。而沿既有车辙行驶能带来更好的牵引力、可预测的车辆动力学和已验证的路径稳定性，因此需要专门检测车辙的方法。
AI.method: 采用低成本、自监督方案；利用同步的RGB-I（RGB+长波红外）影像；通过将GNSS数据中记录的未来车轮轨迹投影来自动生成训练标签；设计神经网络，基于4通道RGB-I图像在白色迷茫路面上识别车辙。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法在视觉单调、缺乏特征的恶劣环境中有效，为冬季自动驾驶提供了稳健且经济的替代方案；同时发布了ThermalTrack数据集。
AI.conclusion: 该自监督RGB-I车辙检测方法在雪覆盖道路上具有实用价值，是冬季自主驾驶的低成本稳健方案，并公开了ThermalTrack数据集供后续研究使用。

title: OpenMobile-2: Building Versatile Mobile Agents with Scalable Environments and App-Native Tools
summary: We introduce OpenMobile-2, a near-frontier mobile agent with fully open training environments and recipes. We make three key advances: (1) Diverse environments with simulated commercial apps: We build MobileGym++, featuring 35 realistic, functionally rich commercial-style apps with cross-app workflows, while preserving full controllability for reset and verification. Together with newly configured apps in Android emulators, this yields a diverse playground spanning over 110 apps. (2) Open training data at scale: Building on this foundation, we curate nearly 12K mobile interaction trajectories for supervised fine-tuning and the largest open collection of verifiable RL training data for mobile agents, comprising over 2K executable tasks with automatic rewards. (3) Hybrid GUI and app-native tool use: We explore an experimental mobile-use setting where apps expose selected functionalities as app-native tools alongside their GUIs, allowing agents to interleave GUI actions and tool calls within a task. We implement this setting in MobileGym++ with over 300 carefully scoped tools across 50+ apps. Additionally, we introduce MobileGym++ Bench for complex, long-horizon commercial mobile scenarios, supporting both GUI-only and hybrid GUI-tool evaluation on a shared task suite. OpenMobile-2 performs competitively across established benchmarks, including AndroidWorld (79.9) and MobileWorld (50.4), while showing promising transfer to real-device mobile use, nearly doubling SPA-Bench performance from 31.9 to 59.6. All resources are available at https://os-copilot.github.io/OpenMobile2-Home/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OpenMobile-2，一个在完全开放训练环境与配方下构建的近前沿移动智能体，通过构建含110+应用的可控模拟环境、约12K监督微调轨迹与2K+可验证强化学习任务，并探索GUI与原生工具混合使用设定，在AndroidWorld、MobileWorld上表现优异，且真实设备迁移能力显著提升。
AI.motivation: 移动智能体研究受限于训练环境不开放、数据规模不足以及任务复杂度低，导致难以复现与迁移至真实设备。作者希望提供完全开放的训练环境和配方，以推动近前沿移动智能体的可复现研究。
AI.method: （1）构建MobileGym++，包含35个功能丰富的商业风格应用及跨应用工作流，保留完全的可重置与验证可控性，并结合Android模拟器新配置应用共覆盖110+应用；（2）整理近12K条移动交互轨迹用于监督微调，以及最大的可验证强化学习数据集合，含2K+带自动奖励的可执行任务；（3）探索GUI与原生工具混合设定，在50+应用中实现300+精心定义的原生工具，使智能体可在任务中交错执行GUI操作与工具调用。
AI.result: OpenMobile-2在AndroidWorld上取得79.9、MobileWorld上取得50.4的竞争性成绩，并将SPA-Bench性能从31.9提升至59.6，接近翻倍，在真实设备移动使用上展现出良好的迁移能力。同时提出MobileGym++ Bench，支持共享任务套件上的纯GUI与混合GUI-工具评估。
AI.conclusion: 通过开放训练环境、规模化数据与混合GUI-工具设定，OpenMobile-2验证了开放配方可支撑近前沿移动智能体的训练，并具备向真实设备迁移的潜力，相关资源已公开以促进后续研究。

title: Video-Arena: A Scalable Agentic Video Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Capability
summary: Understanding and tracking a dynamic world are fundamental to visual intelligence. Existing video benchmarks provide limited insight into whether models can maintain a coherent understanding of evolving world state. Building such a benchmark from real-world videos is challenging because the underlying world state is partially observable, making annotations hard to obtain. To close this gap, we introduce Video-Arena, a benchmark that turns competitive games into scalable, verifiable tests of how well models understand evolving world states from videos. Specifically, inspired by how humans understand dynamic events, we evaluate spatiotemporal world state understanding and tracking through three task categories: perceiving critical events, interpreting state updates, and tracking the resulting states. Our pipeline can generate videos and aligned reference labels from game records at scale. To keep evaluation affordable and reproducible, we curate a golden set of 180 tasks across 9 games and run evaluations under two protocols: native visual understanding and tool-assisted agentic analysis. The best-performing systems achieve F1 scores of and under the two protocols, respectively. The result highlights that native models struggle to perceive events reliably, while tool-assisted systems improve event recovery but still struggle to interpret state updates and track the resulting states consistently over time. Our project page is in https://videoarena-bench.github.io

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Video-Arena，一个将竞技游戏转化为可扩展、可验证测试的基准，用于评估模型从视频中理解和追踪动态世界状态的能力，涵盖三个任务类别与两种评测协议。
AI.motivation: 现有视频基准难以判断模型能否维持对不断演化世界状态的一致理解；而直接从真实视频构建此类基准困难，因为底层世界状态只能部分观测，标注难以获取。因此需要一种可扩展、可验证的替代方案。
AI.method: 受人类理解动态事件方式启发，将竞技游戏转化为测试平台，评估时空世界状态理解与追踪，划分三个任务类别：感知关键事件、解释状态更新、追踪由此产生的状态。其流水线可从游戏记录大规模生成视频及对齐的参考标签，并精选覆盖9款游戏、共180个任务的金标准集合，在两种协议下评测：原生视觉理解与工具辅助的智能体分析。
AI.result: 最佳系统在两种协议下分别取得 F1 分数（摘要中数值缺失）。结果表明：原生模型难以可靠感知事件；工具辅助系统改善了事件恢复，但在解释状态更新和随时间一致追踪结果状态方面仍有困难。
AI.conclusion: Video-Arena 为视频世界状态理解提供了可扩展、可验证的基准，揭示当前模型在事件感知与状态追踪上的系统性不足，为后续研究指明方向。

title: Disentangling Task-Relevant Latent Dynamics for Reward Modeling
summary: Reward design remains a major bottleneck for reinforcement learning in robotic manipulation. Handcrafted dense rewards can compensate for the limited guidance provided by sparse rewards, but require substantial task-specific reward engineering. Learning rewards from videos provides a scalable, data-driven alternative to manual reward design. However, existing video-based rewards are often computed in entangled visual spaces where task-relevant state changes are confounded with extraneous visual variation. As a result, the learned reward may respond to visual distractors instead of actual task execution. To address this limitation, we propose DiTaR (Disentangling Task-Relevant Latent Dynamics for Reward Modeling), a framework for learning dense rewards from heterogeneous videos. DiTaR learns a continuous task-relevant representation from multi-frame video latents through an asymmetric two-stage procedure that suppresses task-irrelevant visual variation. In the task-relevant latent space, we train a history- and language-conditioned rectified-flow model to capture task dynamics and derive a directional dense reward from temporal changes in dynamics compatibility. Together, these components enable reward modeling directly over task-relevant dynamics rather than generic visual variation. DiTaR substantially improves policy learning on MetaWorld-v3 and ManiSkill over video-based reward baselines, and transfers to real-world offline RL through reward relabeling. Reward analyses further show that DiTaR provides more reliable rewards.

AI.tldr: DiTaR提出一种从异构视频中学习稠密奖励的框架，通过非对称两阶段过程解耦任务相关隐动态，在任务相关隐空间用历史与语言条件化整流流模型建模动态并导出方向性奖励，在MetaWorld-v3、ManiSkill及真实离线RL上优于视频奖励基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作中强化学习的奖励设计是主要瓶颈：手工稠密奖励需大量任务特定工程，稀疏奖励指导不足；从视频学习奖励虽可扩展，但现有视频奖励在纠缠的视觉空间中计算，任务相关状态变化与无关视觉变化混杂，导致奖励响应视觉干扰而非真实任务执行。
AI.method: DiTaR（Disentangling Task-Relevant Latent Dynamics for Reward Modeling）从多帧视频隐变量中，通过非对称两阶段过程学习连续的任务相关表示以抑制任务无关视觉变化；在该任务相关隐空间中，训练历史与语言条件化的整流流（rectified-flow）模型以捕获任务动态，并基于动态兼容性的时序变化导出方向性稠密奖励，从而在任务相关动态而非通用视觉变化上直接建模奖励。
AI.result: 在MetaWorld-v3和ManiSkill上显著提升策略学习效果，优于基于视频的奖励基线；通过奖励重标注（reward relabeling）迁移至真实世界离线RL；奖励分析表明DiTaR提供更可靠的奖励。
AI.conclusion: 将视频奖励建模从纠缠的通用视觉空间转移到解耦的任务相关动态空间，可缓解视觉干扰对奖励的误导，为机器人操作提供可扩展且可靠的稠密奖励来源，并具备向真实离线RL迁移的潜力。

title: Beyond the Snowflakes: Disentangling Weather Effects from Confounding Meta-Factors in LiDAR Object Detection
summary: Light Detection and Ranging (LiDAR) is critical for autonomous perception, yet its performance is known to degrade in adverse weather. While existing literature models snow as atmospheric noise that degrades performance, our granular evaluation on the WADS-3D and CADC datasets reveals a counter-intuitive phenomenon: detection accuracy consistently improves as snow intensity increases. Through ablation study and meta-information analysis, we reconcile this by confirming that while falling snow acts as noise, its negative impact is outweighed by a dominant, concurrent factor: significantly increased object point count. We hypothesize that this object point count boost acts as a geometric enhancement, driven by snow accumulation increasing vehicle surface area and a shift from specular to diffuse reflectance. Our findings demonstrate that evaluating perception systems using broad weather-severity bins without accounting for correlated object-level data can lead to misleading conclusions about detector robustness. We conclude that accurate evaluation requires decoupling atmospheric noise from surface accumulation effects and outline future research to validate these physical models. The WADS-3D dataset is available at: https://digitalcommons.mtu.edu/wads-3d/.

AI.tldr: 在WADS-3D与CADC数据集上发现雪强增加时检测精度反而提升，归因于物体点数增加这一几何增强效应超过落雪噪声的负面影响，指出按天气严重度粗粒度评估的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有文献普遍将雪视为退化感知性能的大气噪声，评估多采用天气严重度分档，未区分大气噪声与物体表面累积等耦合因素，可能得出误导性的鲁棒性结论。
AI.method: 在WADS-3D和CADC数据集上进行细粒度评估，并开展消融实验与元信息分析，考察雪强度、物体点数与检测精度的关系。
AI.result: 检测精度随雪强度增加而持续提升；落雪噪声确实存在，但其负面影响被同期显著增加的物体点数所掩盖。
AI.conclusion: 物体点数增加构成几何增强，推测由积雪增大车辆表面积以及镜面反射向漫反射转变所致。准确评估需解耦大气噪声与表面累积效应，且不应在忽略物体级相关数据的情况下使用宽泛天气严重度分档。后续工作将验证这些物理模型。

title: Task Context Shapes Component Roles in Language Models
summary: Large language models reuse the same attention heads across tasks, but identifying these shared heads does not explain what they do differently in each task. A natural source of inspiration is task-dependent interactions among shared brain regions, which motivate a network view of language-model computation. Here, we compare fixed model components across tasks using identical graph facts, statements specifying which directed connections are present. We measure how interventions affect attention heads and the activation state in later layers (influence), as well as the answer (importance). Task changes redistribute the influence in five open-weight models spanning four families and 1.5-14 billion parameters. In Gemma-2-9B and Qwen3-14B, an activation edit changes an early internal activation vector and switches which fact the model reads while the written instruction stays fixed. The same heads then respond to different graph facts and influence later components differently. For each prompt, we construct two linear response maps, one before the edit and one after it. Each map predicts a later head's response from a measured change in an earlier head. For a separate factual intervention, the map for the corresponding condition reduces mean squared prediction error by 53.6% in Gemma and 5.0% in Qwen compared with the average of the two maps. These findings show that task context changes both which graph facts the shared components respond to and how their outputs affect later computation. A network account may help explain how models use shared parameters to perform different computations. Measurements of task-dependent influence could also guide interventions intended to alter one behavior while preserving others.

AI.tldr: 该论文以"共享脑区任务依赖交互"为类比，通过图事实（graph facts）干预，测量共享注意力头在不同任务下的影响（influence）与重要性（importance），发现任务改变了共享组件的响应对象及其对后续计算的作用方式。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在不同任务间复用相同的注意力头，但仅识别这些共享头无法解释它们在各任务中究竟做了什么不同的事；神经科学中共享脑区存在任务依赖交互，启发以网络视角理解语言模型计算。
AI.method: 使用相同的图事实（指明哪些有向连接存在的陈述）在不同任务下比较固定的模型组件；对注意力头及后续层激活状态施加干预，分别测量影响（influence）与答案重要性（importance）。在四个家族、1.5–14B 参数的五个开放权重模型上测试；在 Gemma-2-9B 与 Qwen3-14B 中通过编辑一个早期内部激活向量切换模型读取的事实，同时保持书面指令不变，并构建编辑前后各一个线性响应映射，由早期头的变化预测后续头的响应。
AI.result: 任务变化重新分配了影响；同一批头在编辑后对不同图事实产生响应并差异化影响后续组件。在独立的 factual 干预下，对应条件的响应映射相较两映射平均，将均方预测误差在 Gemma 中降低 53.6%、在 Qwen 中降低 5.0%。
AI.conclusion: 任务语境同时改变共享组件所响应的图事实及其输出对后续计算的作用；网络式解释有助于说明模型如何用共享参数执行不同计算，且任务依赖影响的测量可为"只改变某一行为而保留其他行为"的干预提供指导。

title: Structural Automata for Neural Semantic Parsing
summary: Neural semantic parsers generate meaning representations token by token, yet well-formedness depends on references, scope, and graph relations that unfold during generation. Constrained decoding prevents locally invalid tokens but does not guarantee that a valid prefix can be completed within a fixed output-length limit. We investigate structural automata at three stages of DRS parsing (decoding, post hoc processing, and training) and additionally evaluate decoding on AMR. For decoding, we introduce accepting-path decoding (APD), which maintains a verified completion within the remaining length limit and follows the model's preferred token whenever that token can also be completed. APD guarantees an accepted output without retracting tokens.
